Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step

Copilot ko customize karna aur agents banana — poori kitab ke Hinglish notes. 13 chapters, 2 appendices, har step-by-step exercise ke saath. Neeche saare sections hain — sidebar se kisi bhi chapter par jao.

Kaise padhein: Pehle Chapter 1-2 se agent design samjho, phir Chapter 3-4 se apna pehla agent banao, aur Chapter 5-13 se autonomous agents, knowledge, topics, tools, publishing aur monitoring seekho. Appendix A aur B mein do poore end-to-end projects hain.

00.1 Kitab ko kaise use karein — Step by Step approach

Ye kitab Microsoft Copilot Studio seekhne ke liye hai — ek low-code platform jisme tum natural language se AI agent bana sakte ho, bina code likhe. Har chapter mein concept pehle samjhaya gaya hai, phir numbered steps se haath se karke dikhaya gaya hai, aur end mein Skills review aur Practice tasks hain.

Ye kitab kiske liye hai

Ye kitab un logo ke liye hai jo business processes ko AI agents se badalna chahte hain — low-code makers, IT administrators, aur wo information workers jo apne daily kaam mein agents banana chahte hain. Code likhna zaroori nahi hai; zyada tar kaam graphical interface se hota hai. Professional developers ke liye bhi pro-code raaste hain (jaise VS Code extension aur Azure AI Foundry integration), lekin kitab ka focus low-code experience par hai.

Step by Step approach kaise kaam karta hai

  • Numbered steps — har procedure ko step 1, 2, 3… karke likha gaya hai, taaki tum screen par exactly follow kar sako.
  • TIP — chhota hint ya shortcut jo kaam aasan bana de.
  • IMPORTANT — wo baat jo miss ki to kaam atak sakta hai ya galti ho sakti hai.
  • SEE ALSO — usi topic par kitab mein aur kahan detail hai.
  • Interface objects — screen par jo button ya option select karna hai, wo bold mein likha hota hai.
  • User input — jo text tumhe type karna hai, wo alag style mein dikhaya gaya hai.
  • Chapter thumb tabs — har chapter ko page ke kinare wale tab se pehchano; Practice tasks wale pages par poori stripe hoti hai.

Practice files

Exercises karne ke liye practice files download karni hoti hain — kitab ke companion page se. Sirf ek chapter (topics wala) mein ek practice file hai — ek JSON file jisme adaptive card ka code hai. Baaki chapters mein practice tasks ke liye koi file nahi chahiye; tum apne trial environment mein hi sab kar sakte ho.

Yaad rakhna: Copilot Studio ek paid subscription hai. Kitab ke examples aur practice tasks tum free trial se kar sakte ho, lekin production mein agent publish karne ke liye message consumption ke liye pay karna padega.

Copilot Studio badalta rehta hai — ye baat dhyaan mein rakho

Generative AI tools bahut tezi se evolve ho rahe hain, aur Copilot Studio mein baar-baar naye features aate hain. Isliye kitab mein principles par zyada zor hai — “kaise” ke saath “kyun” bhi samjhaya gaya hai — taaki UI thoda badal bhi jaye to bhi tum follow kar sako. Latest changes ke liye kitab mein har section mein official documentation ke links diye gaye hain, aur errata (galtiyon ki list) companion page par milti hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

00.2 Copilot Studio ek jhalak mein — kya seekhoge

Kaam karne ka tareeka badal raha hai. Pehle log alag-alag apps aur browser tabs mein jaakar kaam karte the. Ab kaam tumhare paas aata hai — intelligent systems context, collaboration, actions aur tasks ko ek hi jagah le aate hain. Copilot Studio isi badlav ka centre hai.

AI adoption ke 3 patterns

Kitab ke shuruaat mein AI use karne ke 3 patterns bataye gaye hain — aur in teeno ko banana hi Copilot Studio ka kaam hai:

  1. Real-time collaboration — insaan aur intelligent agent daily productivity ke flow mein saath kaam karte hain. Agent seconds mein respond karta hai, tumhari capability badhata hai, aur tum creativity aur judgment par focus kar sakte ho.
  2. Delegation — har step khud karne ke bajaye tum meaningful tasks agent ko assign karte ho. Agent plan banata hai, execute karta hai, sawaal poochta hai, aur result review ke liye wapas laata hai.
  3. Trigger-based automation — agent apne aap, trusted guardrails (jaise budget, service level, customer satisfaction) ke andar kaam karta hai. Sirf exception aane par hi insaan se input maangta hai.

Is kitab mein kya milega

Ye SPA poori kitab ko cover karta hai — 13 chapters aur 2 appendices:

  • Ch 1–2: Copilot Studio kya hai, agent ke types, orchestration, aur cost.
  • Ch 3–4: Lite experience aur full Copilot Studio mein agent banana.
  • Ch 5: Autonomous agents — jo apne aap kaam karte hain.
  • Ch 6–8: Knowledge se grounding, topics likhna, aur tools se extend karna.
  • Ch 9–10: Multi-agent systems, publishing aur authentication.
  • Ch 11–13: Monitoring, voice, aur Azure AI ke saath extension.
  • Appendix A–B: Do poore end-to-end agents — IT helpdesk aur customer support.

Har section ke end mein Source diya gaya hai, aur end mein Trust Check se tum khud verify kar sakte ho ki kitab ka har chapter cover hua hai ya nahi.

Seedhi baat

Agent banana ab sirf developers ka kaam nahi raha. Agar tum business process samajhte ho, to tum Copilot Studio mein agent bana sakte ho — aur ye kitab wahi sikhati hai, step by step.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

01.1 Copilot Studio kya hai — low-code SaaS platform

Microsoft Copilot Studio ek low-code platform hai jisse AI-powered agents banaye jaate hain. Tum isse stand-alone agents bana sakte ho jo business processes badal dein, Microsoft 365 Copilot ko nayi skills aur connections se extend kar sakte ho, ya custom agent solutions bana sakte ho.

SaaS platform — kuch install nahi karna

Copilot Studio ek full end-to-end Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform hai — na koi infrastructure deploy karna hai, na maintain karna hai, aur na models train karne hain. Jab tum agent banate ho, wo turant live ho jata hai aur use ke liye ready rehta hai. Ye Microsoft ke Responsible AI platform par bana hai, isliye isme management, governance, regulatory compliance aur data security ke built-in controls hain.

Low-code + pro-code, dono

  • Low-code: makers graphical interface se agents banate hain — bina code ke. Subject-matter experts natural language mein respond karke badalti hui needs par turant react kar sakte hain.
  • Pro-code (hybrid): professional developers VS Code extension se agents ko VS Code ke andar se edit kar sakte hain. Azure AI Foundry ke integration se custom ya highly tuned models banakar low-code makers ko diye ja sakte hain.
  • Kitab ka focus low-code interface par hai — bina code ke agent banana aur publish karna.

Kis type ke agents bana sakte ho

Agent ka typeKya karta hai
Simple retrieval agentBusiness data ke basis par sawaalon ke jawab deta hai
Task agentChat mein tasks complete karta hai — details maangna, record update karna
Autonomous agentKhud reason karke, decisions lekar, tasks independently karta hai
Multi-agent systemHar agent ek process mein specialist; zaroorat par ek dusre ko handoff karte hain

Agents internal ho sakte hain (employees ke liye — employee experience behtar karna) ya external (customers ya suppliers ke liye — bade scale par self-service).

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

01.2 Agent kya hota hai — chat vs autonomous

Agent ek AI-powered assistant hai jo tumhari taraf se kaam karta hai — information retrieve karta hai, tasks karta hai, users se interact karta hai, aur context, instructions, available knowledge aur tools ke basis par business goals achieve karta hai.

Traditional automation se farak

Traditional automation fixed, deterministic workflows follow karti hai — “if this, then that” rules. Agent aisa nahi karta. Agent large language models aur generative AI use karke intent aur business goals ko interpret karta hai, knowledge aur tools par reason karke plan banata hai, aur runtime par best course of action follow karta hai. Isliye wo complex processes handle kar sakta hai jisme reasoning ya decisions chahiye — jo deterministic rules se automate nahi ho sakte.

Do tarah ke agents

  • Chat-based agent: user seedha chat mein interact karta hai — sawaal poochta hai, agent jawab deta hai ya task karta hai.
  • Autonomous agent: kisi event par trigger hokar business process independently chalata hai; insaan se tabhi interact karta hai jab zaroorat ho (human in the loop).

Information work ka future — 3 stages

  1. Employees AI assistants use karte hain.
  2. Humans aur agents teams mein digital colleagues ki tarah saath kaam karte hain.
  3. Humans direction set karte hain, aur agents autonomously business processes execute karte hain.

Jaise-jaise agents productivity aur process automation ka everyday tool ban rahe hain, inhe banana aur use karna information workers ke liye ek critical skill ban raha hai.

Yaad rakhna: Agent sirf chatbot nahi hai. Chatbot sawaal-jawab karta hai; agent knowledge aur tools par reason karke actions bhi leta hai — record nikalna, status update karna, approval lena, aur kaam complete karke wapas report karna.

01.3 Free trial sign up karna

Kitab ke practical exercises follow karne ke liye tumhe Copilot Studio free trial chahiye. Trial sign up karne ke liye Microsoft work, school, ya developer account chahiye.

Trial sign up karne ke steps

  1. copilotstudio.microsoft.com par jao.
  2. Apne work, school, ya developer account se sign in karo.
  3. Apna country/region select karo, phir Start free trial select karo.
  4. Welcome screen par Next se welcome messages dekho ya Skip karke seedha Copilot Studio home page par jao.
  5. Ab tum Copilot Studio home page par ho — is site ko bookmark kar lo, kyunki yahi se har exercise shuru hogi.
IMPORTANT — work account restriction: Kuch organizations mein work accounts trials ke liye sign up nahi kar sakte ya dusri Microsoft services se connect nahi ho sakte. Agar tumhara work account access na de, to Microsoft 365 Developer Program se sign up karo (eligibility conditions apply), ya Microsoft 365 Business trial lo — phir us account se Copilot Studio trial sign up karo. Kitab ke saare exercises ke liye aisa Microsoft 365 business account ya trial recommended hai jisme SharePoint aur Outlook included hon.
IMPORTANT — Microsoft 365 Copilot ka koi free trial nahi: Microsoft 365 Copilot sirf paid license par milta hai. Kitab mein kuch exercises lite experience aur Microsoft 365 Copilot ko extend karne ke baare mein hain — wo tabhi follow kar paoge jab tumhare paas paid Microsoft 365 Copilot license ho.

Trial ke baad kya

Trial environment mein tum agents bana sakte ho, test kar sakte ho, aur practice tasks kar sakte ho. Production mein agents publish karne ke liye message consumption ke liye pay karna padega — cost ka detail Chapter 2 mein hai.

01.4 Pehla agent — describe karke banana

Copilot Studio mein agent banane ke 3 tareeke hain: (1) natural language prompt se describe karke, (2) template se shuru karke, (3) low-code configuration experience se. Is section mein tum pehla tareeka use karke ek basic agent banate ho — jo ek website se connected hota hai.

Example: customer questions ka agent

Hum ek agent banayenge jo customers ke Surface devices ke baare mein sawaalon ke jawab de. Steps ye hain:

  1. Prompt area mein ek sentence likho — jaise “Help answer customer questions about Microsoft Surface devices” — aur send karo.
  2. Tum Copilot conversational experience par redirect ho jaoge. Screen ke main hisse mein Copilot ke saath chat hai; right side par output panel hai jisme agent ki description aur instructions banti jaati hain. Jaise-jaise tum chat mein refine karte ho, right side ka output update hota rehta hai.
  3. Agent ka naya naam do ya suggested naam confirm karo. Agent ke naam ki maximum length 30 characters hai. Naam confirm karte hi output panel mein naam update ho jayega.
  4. Copilot ab instructions refine karne ko kahega — agent ko kya karna hai, uske main tasks ya goals kya hain. Chat mein likho: “Provide information about the latest Surface models and help customers compare and find the right option for their needs.”
  5. Ab Copilot publicly available data sources maangega. Website ka URL do — jaise https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/surface. URL sirf 2 levels deep tak hi use kar sakte ho (ye ek limitation hai).
  6. Ab tone ya language ke baare mein batao — jaise “Maintain a friendly and enthusiastic tone, always happy to help the customer with any questions. Your answers should be accurate and clear to non-technical customers.” Right-side output mein change dikhega.
  7. Upar right mein Create button select karo.
  8. Agent banne ka wait karo. Ready hote hi tum main agent configuration screen par redirect ho jaoge — jisme Name, Description, General Instructions aur Knowledge dikhega, aur right side mein test pane hoga.
  9. Test pane mein prompt daalo: “How does the Surface Pro compare to the Surface Laptop?”
  10. Agent knowledge source search karke AI-generated answer dega. Test karte waqt main screen par activity map dikhega — kaunse knowledge sources search kiye, kaunsa source answer banane mein use hua, aur session kab complete hua.
  11. Left navigation rail par Home icon select karke home page par wapas jao.
  12. Tumhara agent ab home page ke Recent section mein dikhega — wahan se select karke dobara open aur edit kar sakte ho.
Samajhne wali baat

Ye conversational building experience beginners ke liye hai — natural language se jaldi shuru kar sakte ho. Experienced makers aam taur par ise skip karke seedha low-code configuration experience par jaate hain, jo Chapter 4 mein hai.

01.5 Microsoft ka agent-building toolset aur agent architecture

Microsoft ke paas alag-alag agent-building tools hain — use case, maker ki skill, aur kitni customization chahiye, is par depend karta hai ki kaunsa tool use hoga. Copilot Studio is toolset ke centre mein hai.

3 levels ka toolset

LevelKaun banata haiTool
Business productivityInformation workersMicrosoft 365 Copilot app mein Copilot Studio ka lite experience
Business process transformationLow-code makersCopilot Studio (full experience)
Custom agent solutionsProfessional developersAzure AI Foundry, Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit aur SDK

Lite experience Microsoft 365 Copilot mein embedded hai — simplified, limited experience. Tum natural language instructions se agent ka behavior, tone aur scope direct kar sakte ho, limited knowledge sources aur tools add kar sakte ho. Ye agents sirf Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat mein publish aur use ho sakte hain. Full options (grounding, tools, aur capabilities) ke liye full Copilot Studio mein agent banao aur use Microsoft 365 Copilot par channel ke roop mein publish karo.

Azure AI Foundry mein thousands of models hain aur training, orchestration, grounding, reasoning aur integration par poora control milta hai. Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry ke saath integrated hai — wahan banaye gaye data aur models ko Copilot Studio agent mein use kar sakte ho, jaise custom, fine-tuned ya industry-specific models.

Agent architecture ke 5 key components

  1. Experience — user agent se kaise interact karta hai, ya event trigger par agent bina UI ke background mein chalta hai. Channels: Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, websites, apps, social media aur dusre chat channels.
  2. Knowledge — agent ke paas kaunsi information hai. Knowledge add karne ko “grounding” kehte hain — agent ko business context dena, jisse hallucination ka risk substantially kam ho jata hai.
  3. Tools — agent kya actions le sakta hai: connectors, REST APIs, agent flows, prompts, MCP servers.
  4. Orchestrator — agent decide karta hai ki kab kaunsa knowledge source ya tool use kare — generative ya classic orchestration.
  5. Models — kaunsa language model reasoning aur answers ke liye use hoga; Azure AI Foundry se apna model bhi la sakte ho.

Use cases — internal aur external

  • Internal agents (employees ke liye): HR, sales, service, supply chain processes mein madad; information dhoondhna aasan karna.
  • External agents (customers/suppliers ke liye): website ya app par self-service — customers khud answers paayein aur transactions karein.
  • Success metrics: har use case ke liye pehle se decide karo ki success kaise measure karoge — jaise resolution rate, time saved, ya customer satisfaction.
Tip: Agent store mein prebuilt agents hain jo Microsoft 365 Copilot ko extend karte hain aur turant deploy karke use kiye ja sakte hain. Ye acche examples hain ki tum khud kis type ke agents bana sakte ho.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

02.1 Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot ya stand-alone agent?

Agent banana shuru karne se pehle pehla decision ye hai: Microsoft 365 Copilot ko extend karna hai ya stand-alone agent banana hai? Ye decision agent ki performance, capability aur cost par asar dalta hai.

Microsoft 365 Copilot extend karo jab…

  • Tumhare users ke paas Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses hain, ya wo daily work mein Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat use karte hain, aur scenario usi experience mein fit baithta hai.
  • Tum Microsoft 365 Copilot chat experience ka customized version chahte ho — apne business needs ya use case ke hisaab se.
  • Tum chahte ho ki Microsoft 365 Copilot tumhare enterprise data sources ya domain knowledge par reason kare.
  • Tum chahte ho ki Microsoft 365 Copilot specific tasks, workflows ya business processes handle kare jo Microsoft 365 products ke bahar line-of-business systems se connected hon.

Stand-alone agent banao jab…

  • Agent external-facing hai — customer ya supplier self-service ke liye. (Microsoft 365 Copilot extend karna sirf internal-facing agents ke liye suitable hai.)
  • Agent internal hai, lekin users ke paas Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses nahi hain, ya wo free Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat daily use nahi karte.
  • Tum Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat ke bahar kisi internal channel par publish karna chahte ho — company ke business applications, mobile apps, internal websites — ya multiple internal channels par.
  • Tum agent ki branding ya user experience par zyada control chahte ho.
  • Tum language models, orchestration, knowledge sources, instructions ya responses par zyada control aur choice chahte ho.
  • Tumhara use case multi-agent system se best serve hota hai.
Tip: Copilot Studio mein ek hi agent banao aur multiple channels par publish karo. Ek agent internal se shuru hokar external bhi ban sakta hai — pehle internal agent customer service representatives ko information dhoondhne mein madad kare, phir refine hokar website par customer-facing external agent ban jaye. Ye customer self-service agents mein common pattern hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

02.2 Agent ke 3 type — conversational, autonomous, multi-agent

Dusra decision: agent kis type ka hoga? Teen options hain — aur sahi choice tumhare scenario par depend karti hai.

1. Conversational agents

Ye wo agents hain jinse hum sabse zyada familiar hain — website par “bot” se chat karna, consumer AI tools use karna, ya kaam par Microsoft 365 Copilot use karna. Conversational agent chat interface mein natural language mein interact karta hai — sawaalon ke jawab deta hai, processes guide karta hai, ya tasks complete karta hai.

Kab use karein: jab scenario typically user-initiated ho — user khud sawaal poochne ya help lene aaye. Information retrieval wale agents aam taur par conversational hote hain. Ye tasks bhi kar sakte hain — jaise customer se details maangna, line-of-business system se unka transaction nikalna, status update karna, aur confirmation wapas dena. Ye knowledge ya internal systems ka “front door” hain — user ko context aur applications switch karne se bachate hain.

2. Autonomous agents

Autonomous agents kisi event se trigger hote hain — jaise form submission, incoming email, ya database mein nayi row — aur background mein bina chat experience ke apne aap chalte hain. Ye business process aur workflow automation ke naye scenarios kholte hain jo pehle possible nahi the.

Ye traditional “if this, then that” workflow automation se zyada kar sakte hain: tum trigger define karte ho, knowledge, tools aur instructions dete ho, aur agent generative AI se reason karke best course of action decide karta hai — independently operate karta hai aur human se tabhi interact karta hai jab zaroorat ho. Deterministic flows bhi invoke kar sakta hai un parts ke liye jo fixed aur structured rehne chahiye (jaise database se order record nikalna), phir generative AI par wapas aa jata hai.

IMPORTANT: Autonomous agents generative orchestration use karte hain; classic orchestration se autonomous agent design nahi kar sakte.

3. Multi-agent systems

Multi-agent system mein har agent ke paas alag knowledge, tools aur responsibilities hoti hain, aur agents ek dusre ko handoff kar sakte hain ya saath kaam kar sakte hain.

Kab single, kab multiple: single agent tab best hai jab agent ek clearly defined business domain ya knowledge source ke andar kaam karega. Agar tumhare agent design mein 4 ya 5 se zyada knowledge sources ya tools chahiye, to multiple agents se likely better performance milegi. Example: banking scenario mein personal loans, mortgages aur business banking ke liye alag-alag specialist agents — har agent ke paas sirf apne domain ke knowledge sources aur tools, aur zaroorat par dusre agents ko call ya handoff.

Copilot Studio mein multi-agent system do tareekon se banta hai: ek hi agent ke andar “child” agents design karke, ya apne agent ko dusre existing agents se connect karke. Detail Chapter 9 mein hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

02.3 Orchestration — generative vs classic

Orchestration layer control karta hai ki agent kaunse knowledge sources aur tools kab use kare. Copilot Studio mein do options hain — generative orchestration aur classic (deterministic) orchestration. Ye choice capability, performance aur cost par asar dalti hai.

Pehle 2 terms samajh lo

  • Intent — user input ke peeche ka goal ya purpose. “User kya karna chahta hai?” Intent se agent samajhta hai ki user ki request kya hai aur sahi answer ya action trigger karna hai.
  • Entity — unstructured user input se nikala gaya specific piece of information — ek known data type ya category, jaise date, location, ya product name — jo agent ko task complete karne ke liye chahiye.
  • Slot filling — agent action lene se pehle saari zaroori information collect karta hai. Entities isi mein use hoti hain.

Example: customer likhta hai — “Hi, I’d like to return the AS49 waterproof jacket I bought from the Chicago store. It’s a men’s size L and it still has the tags on.” Orchestration isme se nikalta hai: Intent: Product return. Entities: Product name — AS49 waterproof jacket; Purchase location — Chicago store; Size — Men’s L; Condition — Tags on.

Generative orchestration (default)

Naya agent banate hi generative orchestration default hoti hai. Ye generative AI se instructions, knowledge aur tools par reason karke decide karti hai ki aage kya karna hai. LLM decide karta hai: “Is user input ke liye best action ya response kya hai?” — knowledge se answer generate karna, topic trigger karna, tool call karna, ya ambiguous input par clarifying question poochna. Multiple topics, tools aur knowledge ko chain karke consolidated answer de sakta hai. Vague ya complex inputs (multiple intents) bhi handle kar leta hai, kyunki ye strict examples se match karne par depend nahi karta.

Entity extraction aur slot filling bhi LLM se hoti hai — context mein meaning samajhkar relevant information nikalta hai, aur follow-up questions automatically poochta hai. Tumhe har piece of information ke liye alag-alag conversational flow banane ki zaroorat nahi.

IMPORTANT: Generative orchestration mein descriptions ki quality ka performance par substantial impact hota hai. Har trigger, knowledge source aur tool ki clear description likho — agar description default ya blank chhod di, to agent ki performance affect hogi. Generative orchestration inhi descriptions se samajhta hai ki har component kis liye hai.

Trade-off: generative zyada “clever” aur powerful hai, lekin classic se kam predictable hai, aur iski consumption cost bhi zyada hai.

Classic orchestration

Classic orchestration NLU (natural language understanding) model use karti hai. Tum topics ke through intents set karte ho — har topic ke liye 5–10 trigger phrases dete ho, jinse NLU intent samajhta hai. Input aane par model intent classify karke sabse suitable topic se match karta hai.

  • Agar koi suitable topic match nahi milta (ya tumne koi topic author hi nahi kiya), to Conversational boosting fallback topic use hota hai — knowledge source se generative AI answer banata hai. Classic mein generative AI knowledge par reason karke answers deta hai, lekin course of action decide nahi karta.
  • Intent classification zyada controlled hoti hai, kyunki tum NLU ko apne trigger phrases se train kar rahe ho. Intents ko carefully map karna padta hai taaki wo disambiguated rahen.
  • Entities defined list se extract hoti hain. Copilot Studio mein out-of-the-box entities hain — jaise age, location, color — aur tum apni custom entities bhi bana sakte ho (jaise product name, size, condition).

Classic ki limitations

  • Ek user input mein sirf ek intent detect kar sakta hai.
  • Straightforward use cases ke liye best hai — jaise password resets, leave requests, address updates, ya policy checks.
  • Zyada predictable, controllable aur cost-effective hai.

Switch karna: agent kholo → Orchestration section → generative AI toggle ko Disabled karo. Save hone mein couple of minutes lagte hain; phir agent classic orchestration use karega. Toggle Enabled par wapas generative ho jata hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

02.4 Agent ki capabilities design karna

Agent ka type aur orchestration chunne ke baad, uski core capabilities design karni hoti hain — scope, brand voice, knowledge, tools, logic, topics, aur fallback/escalation ki planning.

1. Scope aur purpose define karo

Agent kya karega aur kya nahi karega — ye pehle se clear rakho. Scope jitna tight hoga, agent utna accurate hoga. Har agent ke liye ek clear purpose statement likho, jaise “Ye agent customers ko Surface devices compare karne aur sahi option chunne mein madad karta hai.”

2. Brand voice do

Agent kis tone mein baat karega — friendly, formal, enthusiastic? Instructions mein tone likho, kyunki generative answers aur messages isi tone mein aayenge. Conversation Start topic ka greeting message bhi brand voice mein edit karo.

3. Knowledge sources aur tools identify karo

Agent ko kaunsi information chahiye aur kaunse actions karne chahiye — pehle list banao. Knowledge: websites, files, SharePoint, Dataverse, real-time connectors. Tools: connectors, REST APIs, agent flows, prompts, MCP servers. (Detail Ch 6 aur Ch 8 mein.)

4. Logic strategy define karo

Kuch cheezein deterministic logic se karni chahiye (jaise order record nikalna, amount ke basis par branch karna), aur kuch generative reasoning se. Decide karo ki kaunsa hissa kis tareeke se hoga. Topics (Ch 7) mein tum branching logic, conditions aur slot filling design karte ho.

5. Topics identify karo

Topics wo conversations hain jo agent handle karega — har topic ka ek trigger hota hai (classic mein trigger phrases, generative mein description). Har topic ka purpose aur trigger clear likho.

6. Fallback aur escalation ki planning

Agent jab answer na jaane, to kya kare? Fallback — Conversational boosting topic generative answers se jawab deta hai (agar knowledge hai to). Escalation — jab agent solve na kar paye, to human ko handoff karo (jaise customer service representative ko, ya voice channel par). Escalation ke liye pehle se decide karo: kab escalate karna hai, kisko, aur kaunsi information saath bhejni hai. Voice aur customer engagement systems mein escalation Ch 12 mein detail mein hai.

Design ka golden rule

Scope tight rakho, descriptions clear likho, aur fallback pehle se plan karo. In teeno par agent ki accuracy sabse zyada depend karti hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

02.5 Cost samajhna aur calculate karna

Agent design karte waqt cost ko bhi design decision ki tarah treat karo — kyunki har design choice (orchestration, knowledge, tools) cost par asar dalti hai. Copilot Studio mein cost messages se measure hoti hai.

Cost kin cheezon par depend karti hai

  1. Kaunsi capability invoke ho rahi hai — web-grounded answers aur agent actions ki billing rates alag hoti hain.
  2. Orchestration model — generative orchestration ki cost classic se zyada hoti hai, kyunki har turn mein LLM reasoning hoti hai.
  3. Tenant graph grounding, channel, aur user license — agar tenant mein Microsoft 365 Copilot license hai, to tenant graph grounding with semantic search agent ke liye enabled ho jati hai; channel aur license ke hisaab se bhi rates badalti hain.

Licensing ke 2 tareeke

  • Prepaid message packs — tenant ke liye mahine ke hisaab se billed packs of messages khareedo.
  • Pay-as-you-go — consumption ke hisaab se billing; jo use karo, utna pay karo.

Agent usage estimator

Copilot Studio mein agent usage estimator hai — isse tum apne use case ke against cost calculate kar sakte ho. Kitab mein ek worked example hai: Surface Support Guide agent (generative orchestration + web-grounded answers, Microsoft Surface website se connected) — maan lo use roz 1000 single-turn question-answer interactions milte hain. Phir calculate karo: (a) 1000 web-grounded answers ka message consumption, (b) 1000 agent actions ka AI-led orchestration message consumption — dono ko jodo, total mil jayega. Latest billing rates ke liye Power Platform licensing guide download karo (aka.ms/powerplatformlicensingguide) aur usme Microsoft Copilot Studio section dekho.

Tip: Cost optimize karne ka sabse bada lever orchestration choice hai — straightforward, predictable processes (password reset, leave request) ko classic orchestration par chalao; generative sirf wahan use karo jahan reasoning chahiye.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

03.1 Lite experience kya hai

Lite experience Copilot Studio ka simplified, no-code version hai jo Microsoft 365 Copilot app ke andar embedded hota hai. Ye information workers ke liye hai — jo apne liye ya apni chhoti team ke liye jaldi se agent banana chahte hain.

Lite vs full — farak kya hai

Lite experienceFull Copilot Studio
Kahan milta haiMicrosoft 365 Copilot app ke andarcopilotstudio.microsoft.com par
Kaun banata haiInformation workers, no-codeLow-code makers, IT admins
Knowledge/toolsLimited sources aur toolsFull set — grounding, tools, MCP, flows
Publish kahanSirf Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat meinTeams, websites, apps, social media, aur bhi channels
LicenseFree Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat mein aur limitations; full ke liye Microsoft 365 Copilot license ya pay-as-you-goMessage packs ya pay-as-you-go

Lite mein tum natural language instructions se agent ka behavior, tone aur scope direct kar sakte ho, limited knowledge sources aur tools add kar sakte ho, aur agents apne colleagues ke saath share kar sakte ho. Ye agents Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat experience ko extend karte hain — emails aur reports likhna, brainstorm karna, products/projects/policies ke baare mein sawaalon ke jawab dena.

Yaad rakhna: Free Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat mein banaye gaye agents par knowledge sources aur tools ki aur limitations hoti hain — bina Microsoft 365 Copilot license ya pay-as-you-go consumption billing ke. Agar tumhe full capabilities chahiye, to full Copilot Studio mein agent banao aur use Microsoft 365 Copilot par channel ke roop mein publish karo.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

03.2 Lite mein agent describe aur configure karna

Lite experience mein agent banana Chapter 1 wale conversational flow jaisa hi hai — describe karo, configure karo, knowledge aur connectors add karo, test karo.

Describe karke agent banana

  1. Microsoft 365 Copilot app kholo aur agent banane ka option select karo.
  2. Natural language mein describe karo ki agent kya kare — jaise “Help answer customer questions about our products.”
  3. Copilot tumse follow-up sawaal poochkar agent ki description aur instructions banata hai — right side output mein dikhta hai.
  4. Naam confirm karo aur Create karo.

Configure karna — instructions aur knowledge

Agent banne ke baad configuration form mein tum:

  • Instructions edit karo — configuration form ke field mein instructions manually edit kar sakte ho (sirf chat se hi nahi, seedha field mein bhi).
  • Knowledge add karo — “Add knowledge” se website, files ya connectors add karo. Knowledge ke saath name aur description edit karo taaki orchestrator samjhe ki ye knowledge kab use karni hai.
  • Connectors add karo — agent ko tools do taaki wo actions le sake.
  • Test karo — test pane mein sawaal poochkar dekho ki agent knowledge se sahi answer de raha hai ya nahi.
Tip: Lite mein bhi descriptions matter karte hain — knowledge source ya tool ki description jitni clear hogi, generative orchestration use utni sahi jagah use karega.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

03.3 Template se agent banana

Khud se shuru karne ke bajaye template se shuru karna fast hota hai — template mein pehle se description, instructions, knowledge aur tools configured hote hain, tumhe sirf apne use case ke hisaab se customize karna hota hai.

Template se banane ke steps

  1. Create screen par templates ki list dekho.
  2. Apne use case se milta-julta template chuno — jaise customer support, HR help, ya knowledge Q&A.
  3. Template open karke uski description aur instructions padho — samjho ki wo kya karta hai.
  4. Apne data se connect karo: apni website URL ya files knowledge mein add karo.
  5. Instructions ko apne tone aur scope ke hisaab se edit karo.
  6. Test pane mein test karo, phir share karo.

Templates sirf starting point hain — inhe apne business ke hisaab se customize karna hi asli kaam hai. Agent store mein prebuilt agents bhi hain jo Microsoft 365 Copilot ko extend karte hain aur turant deploy ho sakte hain — wo bhi templates ki tarah acche examples hain.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

03.4 Lite agent share aur manage karna

Lite mein bana agent sirf tumhare liye nahi hai — use share karke apne colleagues ke saath use kar sakte ho, aur manage karke update karte reh sakte ho.

Share karna

  • Agent ko share karo taaki colleagues use Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat mein use kar sakein.
  • Share karte waqt decide karo ki kaun use kar sakta hai — specific log ya poori team.
  • Share kiya gaya agent colleagues ke Copilot Chat mein dikhne lagta hai.

Manage karna

  • Agent ko open karke instructions, knowledge aur tools kabhi bhi edit kar sakte ho — changes save hote hi live ho jate hain.
  • Test pane mein naye sawaal poochkar har change ko verify karo.
  • Agar agent kaam theek se na kare, to pehle instructions aur knowledge descriptions check karo — zyada tar problems wahin se aati hain.
  • Lite agent ko full Copilot Studio mein le ja sakte ho jab tumhe zyada capabilities chahiye hon — wahan se multiple channels par publish kar sakte ho.
Lite se full tak ka raasta

Lite se shuru karo, use case prove karo, phir full Copilot Studio mein le jao. Yehi natural progression hai — aur kitab bhi isi order mein aage badhti hai: agla chapter full experience mein agent banana sikhata hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

04.1 Environments aur solutions samajhna

Full Copilot Studio mein agent banane se pehle environments aur solutions samajhna zaroori hai — ye tumhare agents ko organize karne aur safely manage karne ka tareeka hai.

Environment kya hai

Environment ek container hai jisme tumhare agents, data aur settings rehte hain. Alag-alag kaam ke liye alag environments banao — jaise Development (testing ke liye) aur production (real users ke liye). Har environment ka apna region aur Dataverse data store ho sakta hai.

Naya trial environment banana

  1. Power Platform admin center (admin.powerplatform.microsoft.com) par jao.
  2. Left side rail par Manage icon select karo, phir +New se naya environment banao.
  3. Side pane mein naam do — jaise “Development”. Type: Trial select karo, aur Dataverse data store add karo.
  4. Security group options mein Open Access: None select karo.
  5. Done phir Save karo.

Copilot Studio ke andar se bhi environment bana sakte ho: Environments screen par +New → naam (Development), region (tenant ke hisaab se prefilled), Type: Trial, Dataverse data store: Yes → Next → language aur currency waise hi rehne do, Security group mein access set karo.

Environment select karna

Copilot Studio ke top right mein environment picker hota hai — wahan se switch karo ki tum kis environment mein kaam kar rahe ho. Agent hamesha usi environment mein banta hai jo picker mein selected ho. Galat environment mein agent banane se bacho — pehle picker check karo, phir Create dabao.

Solutions kya hain

Solutions agents aur unke related components (flows, tables, connections) ko ek package mein bandhne ka tareeka hai — taaki tum ek environment se dusre environment mein (jaise Development se Production) le ja sako. Solutions ke saath kaam karna application lifecycle management (ALM) ka hissa hai: develop karo, test karo, phir solution export karke production mein import karo.

Tip: Shuru mein hi Development aur production environment alag rakhne ki aadat daalo. Testing production environment mein karna risky hota hai — agent galti se real users ko galat jawab de sakta hai ya real data change kar sakta hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

04.2 Configuration se naya agent banana

Describe karne ke bajaye tum configuration experience se bhi agent bana sakte ho — isme har cheez par tumhara direct control hota hai. Experienced makers aam taur par yahi tareeka use karte hain.

Steps — configuration se agent banana

  1. Create screen par Skip to Configure select karo.
  2. Primary language set karo — agent kis language mein baat karega. Baad mein secondary languages bhi add kar sakte ho.
  3. Agent ka naam aur icon set karo. Naam maximum 30 characters ka ho sakta hai. Icon agent ki pehchan hoti hai — channels par wahi dikhega.
  4. Description aur instructions likho. Description batata hai ki agent kya hai; instructions batate hain ki agent ko kya karna hai, kis tone mein baat karni hai, aur kin rules ko follow karna hai. Instructions jitni clear hongi, agent utna accurate hoga.
  5. Suggested prompts add karo — ye wo starter questions hain jo user ko chat shuru karne mein madad karte hain (jaise “How do I reset my password?”).
  6. Knowledge add karo — websites, files, SharePoint, Dataverse, ya connectors. Knowledge ke saath name aur description edit karna mat bhoolo.
  7. Create select karo aur agent banne ka wait karo. Agent ready hote hi main configuration screen khul jayegi — Overview tab mein Name, Description, Instructions aur Knowledge dikhega, right side mein test pane.

Instructions likhne ke rules

  • Agent ka purpose ek line mein clear likho.
  • Tone aur style specify karo (friendly, formal, concise).
  • Do’s aur don’ts likho — kya karna hai, kya nahi karna.
  • Knowledge sources ka use kab karna hai, wo batao.
  • Generative orchestration mein instructions hi agent ki “brain” hoti hain — vague instructions se vague behavior milega.
Playground Agent

Chapter 6 ke experiments ke liye kitab ek blank “Playground Agent” banane ko kehti hai — sirf naam dekar, baaki sab blank chhodkar, Create dabao. Isi agent par tum knowledge experiments karoge.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

04.3 Agent settings manage karna

Agent banne ke baad uski Settings (top right button) se tum uske behavior ko fine-tune kar sakte ho — reasoning, model, response format aur languages.

Deep reasoning enable karna

Generative AI settings mein deep reasoning model ka toggle milta hai. Deep reasoning on karne se agent complex decisions aur recommendations ke liye zyada gehrai se reason karta hai — jaise policy documents padhkar claim accept, flag ya reject karna. Ye sirf tab kaam karta hai jab agent generative orchestration use kar raha ho.

Response model aur response formatting

Generative AI settings mein tum ye bhi change kar sakte ho:

  • Response model — generative answers ke liye kaunsa model use hoga.
  • Response formatting — generative answers ka format kaisa ho (jaise concise ya detailed).
  • Use general knowledge — LLM ki general (training) knowledge use karni hai ya nahi. Agar off kar do, to agent sirf tumhare knowledge sources se jawab dega.

Primary language edit karna aur secondary languages add karna

Settings se primary language badal sakte ho aur secondary languages add kar sakte ho. Lekin ek IMPORTANT baat: event triggers, generative answers, generative orchestration, user input aur voice ka support har language aur capability ke liye alag-alag stage par hai — kuch features kuch languages mein available nahi hote. Isliye language chunne se pehle check kar lo ki tumhare chahiye gaye features us language mein supported hain ya nahi.

Tip: Settings change karne ke baad Save dabana aur confirmation ka wait karna mat bhoolo, phir test pane refresh karke test karo. Bina refresh ke purana behavior dikhega.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

04.4 Conversation Start topic edit karna

Jab user agent se baat shuru karta hai, to sabse pehle Conversation Start topic trigger hota hai — isme wo greeting message hota hai jo agent bolta hai. Ye tumhare brand voice ko set karne ki pehli jagah hai.

Greeting message edit karne ke steps

  1. Agent configuration screen par top menu se Topics select karo.
  2. System button se automatically generated system topics dikhao.
  3. Conversation Start topic select karke authoring canvas mein kholo.
  4. Message node mein greeting message hai. Message text ke start par select karke expand karo aur edit karo. Message mein agent ka naam ek variable se represent hota hai — us hisse ko waise hi rehne do, baaki text apni brand voice mein likho.
  5. Canvas par Message node ke bahar kahin select karo, phir Save karo.
  6. Test pane refresh karo — agent ab naye greeting se conversation shuru karega.
Tip: Greeting mein user ko batao ki agent kya kar sakta hai — jaise “Hi! Main aapki IT helpdesk agent hoon. Password reset, software requests, ya ticket status — kisi bhi cheez mein madad kar sakti hoon.” Isse user ko turant pata chalta hai ki agent kis kaam ka hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

04.5 Template se shuru karna

Full Copilot Studio mein bhi templates se shuru kar sakte ho — template mein agent ki description, instructions, knowledge aur tools pehle se configured hote hain.

Template se banane ke steps

  1. Create screen par templates browse karo.
  2. Apne scenario se milta template chuno aur use open karke dekho ki usme kya configured hai.
  3. Template se agent create karo.
  4. Phir apne hisaab se customize karo — apni knowledge sources add karo, instructions apne tone mein edit karo, aur tools connect karo.
  5. Test pane mein thoroughly test karo.

Template se shuru karne ka fayda ye hai ki tumhe agent ki structure pehle se mil jati hai — topics, triggers aur settings ke examples dekhkar tum apna agent zyada jaldi aur sahi tareeke se bana sakte ho.

04.6 Managed agent install karna

Khud agent banane ke alawa tum managed agents install bhi kar sakte ho — ye ready-made agents hain jo kisi aur ne banaye hain aur tumhare environment mein deploy ho jate hain.

Example: Wellness Check managed agent

  1. Environment picker (top right) se Development environment select karo — is example mein agent ko Dataverse ki dependency hai, isliye aisa environment chahiye jisme Dataverse ho.
  2. Left side rail mein Home ke neeche Create icon select karo.
  3. Create screen par Install a managed agent section par jao.
  4. Jo agent install karna hai, use select karo — example mein Wellness Check managed agent.
  5. Ek pop-up window khulegi jisme agent ka preview, details aur requirements dikhenge. Review karke install karo.
  6. Install hone ke baad agent tumhare agents ki list mein dikhega — use open karke test karo aur apne hisaab se customize karo.
Yaad rakhna: Managed agent install karne se pehle uski dependencies check karo — jaise Dataverse tables ya connectors. Agar dependency missing hogi, to agent theek se kaam nahi karega.
