05.1 Autonomous agent kab use karein

Autonomous agent wo hai jo kisi event se trigger hokar apne aap kaam karta hai — bina chat ke, background mein. Ye workflow automation se aage ka step hai.

Autonomous agent vs workflow automation

Workflow automationAutonomous agent
LogicFixed “if this, then that” pathGenerative AI se runtime par decide karta hai
DecisionsPehle se defined branchingContext dekhkar dynamic decisions
ReasoningNahi — sirf rules follow karta haiHaan — knowledge aur tools par reason karta hai
Human involvementSirf exceptions parSirf jab zaroorat ho (human in the loop)

Autonomous agent deterministic flows bhi invoke kar sakta hai un parts ke liye jo fixed rehne chahiye (jaise database se record nikalna, amount ke basis par branch karna), phir generative AI par wapas aa jata hai.

Use cases kaise pehchanein

Un business processes ke baare mein socho jo tum pehle automate nahi kar paye kyunki unme human reasoning ya decision making chahiye thi — wahi autonomous agents ke use cases hain. Examples: incoming email padhkar claim process karna, form submission par approval workflow chalana, database mein nayi row aane par follow-up tasks karna.

IMPORTANT: Autonomous agents generative orchestration use karte hain. Triggers sirf un agents ke liye available hote hain jinme generative orchestration enabled ho.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

05.2 Autonomous agent banana — plan se trigger tak

Autonomous agent banana conversational agent se alag soch maangta hai — pehle plan karo, phir trigger, knowledge, tools aur instructions do.

Step 1: Plan karo

Process ko map karo: trigger kya hoga? Agent ko kaunsi knowledge chahiye? Kaunse tools chahiye? Human kab involve hoga? Kaunse decisions agent khud lega aur kaunse deterministic flow se honge?

Step 2: Agent banao aur knowledge + tools add karo

Configuration se agent banao (Chapter 4 wala tareeka), phir use case se related knowledge sources add karo — jaise policy documents — aur tools add karo — jaise connectors ya agent flows jinse agent actions le sake.

Step 3: Instructions likho

Instructions mein clearly likho: agent ko kya karna hai, kis order mein sochna hai, aur decisions kaise leni hain. Example: claim process karte waqt policy documents ko reason karke decide karo ki claim accept, flag ya reject karna hai.

Step 4: Trigger add karo

Trigger wo event hai jo agent ko start karta hai — jaise “jab naya email aaye” ya “jab Dataverse mein nayi row add ho”. Trigger configure karte waqt event ka source aur conditions set karo.

Step 5: Iterate karo aur tools add karte raho

Pehle version ko test karo, dekho agent kahan atak raha hai ya galat decide kar raha hai, phir instructions refine karo aur zaroorat ke tools add karo. Autonomous agents ko ek baar mein perfect banana mushkil hai — iteration hi asli process hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

05.3 Deep reasoning aur iterate karna

Autonomous agent test karte waqt tum notice karoge ki standard orchestration model policy documents par reason karke decisions aur recommendations deta hai — jaise claim accept karna hai, flag karna hai ya reject. Deep reasoning se ye reasoning aur gehri ho jati hai.

Deep reasoning enable karna

  1. Agent ke Settings button (top right) se Settings kholo.
  2. Generative AI section mein Deep reasoning model ka toggle on karo.
  3. Save karo aur changes save hone ka wait karo. Confirmation aayega.
  4. Settings screen ko X se band karo.
  5. Overview tab mein Instructions mein edit karke phrase add karo — jaise “use reason” — taaki agent knowledge use karte waqt reasoning kare.
  6. Test karo aur dekho ki decisions kaise badalti hain.

Iterate karne ka best practice

  • Har test ke baad activity map dekho — agent ne kaunse knowledge sources use kiye, kaunse tools call kiye, aur kahan galat decision li.
  • Instructions mein ek baat badlo, phir dobara test karo — ek saath bahut changes mat karo, warna pata nahi chalega ki kis change se farak pada.
  • Edge cases test karo — jaise incomplete information, ambiguous requests, ya policy ke borderline cases.
  • Jab agent stable ho jaye, tabhi publish karo.
Best practice: Autonomous agent mein deep reasoning tab use karo jab decisions complex hon aur galti costly ho — jaise claims, approvals, ya compliance decisions. Simple tasks ke liye standard reasoning kaafi hai aur cost bhi kam hoti hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

05.4 Autonomous agent publish aur monitor karna

Autonomous agent ko publish karne se pehle use thoroughly test karo — kyunki publish ke baad wo real events par real actions lega.

Publish karna

  • Publish karne se pehle saare test cases pass kar lo — normal cases, edge cases, aur failure cases.
  • Publish ke baad agent trigger events par automatically chalne lagta hai.
  • Shuru mein agent ko limited scope mein publish karo (jaise ek team ya ek process), phir dheere-dheere expand karo.

Monitor karna — activity review

Publish ke baad activity review se dekho ki agent kya kar raha hai:

  • Kaunse runs successful rahe, kaunse fail hue, aur kyun.
  • Agent ne kaunse decisions liye aur kin knowledge sources/tools ka use kiya.
  • Kahan human intervention chahiye thi — aur kya wo sahi jagah thi.
  • Activity se seekhkar instructions aur tools ko improve karo — monitoring ek baar ka kaam nahi, continuous loop hai.
Autonomous ka matlab “bina supervision” nahi

Autonomous agent apne aap kaam karta hai, lekin bina monitoring ke nahi. Activity review hi batata hai ki agent sahi decisions le raha hai ya nahi — aur Chapter 11 mein monitoring ka poora detail hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.1 Knowledge kaise kaam karta hai

Agent ko knowledge add karne ko grounding kehte hain. Grounded agent apne business ki accurate aur relevant information se jawab deta hai — aur hallucination ka risk substantially kam ho jata hai.

Playground Agent set up karna

Is chapter ke experiments ke liye ek blank agent banao:

  1. Naya agent banao aur Skip to Configure select karo.
  2. Naam do: Playground Agent.
  3. Baaki sab sections (description, instructions, prompts, knowledge) blank chhod do.
  4. Create select karo aur agent banne ka wait karo.

LLM ki general knowledge

Playground Agent ka koi knowledge source nahi hai, phir bhi wo sawaalon ke jawab dega — LLM ki general knowledge se, jo model ko training data se mili hai. Recent events ya website-only information ke baare mein poochkar dekho — agent galat ya outdated jawab dega, kyunki uske paas actual policy documents ya websites ka access nahi hai.

General knowledge on/off karna: Settings (top right) → Generative AI settings → Knowledge section → Use general knowledge toggle Off karo → Save karo → Settings band karo → wahi sawaal dobara poochkar test karo. Ab agent mana kar dega ya kahega ki uske paas ye information nahi hai.

Generative answers aur Conversational boosting topic

Jab tum agent mein knowledge add karte ho, to wo generative answers capability use karta hai — knowledge sources se information retrieve karke response banata hai. Tumhare agent mein out-of-the-box system topics hote hain, jinme Conversational boosting topic bhi hai. Ye topic On Unknown Intent trigger par chalta hai — jab agent user ke intent ko kisi aur topic se match nahi kar pata — aur isme Create generative answers node hota hai. Us node ke Data sources section mein Edit link se tum dekh aur edit kar sakte ho ki generative answers ke liye kaunse sources use honge.

Content moderation aur official knowledge sources

Copilot Studio mein content moderation built-in hai — harmful ya inappropriate content ko filter karta hai. Official knowledge sources wo hain jo Microsoft provide karta hai ya tumhare tenant ke official data se aate hain — jaise SharePoint sites aur Dataverse tables. Unofficial ya public web sources se zyada careful rehna chahiye, kyunki unki accuracy tumhare control mein nahi hoti.

Tip: Agent ko test karte waqt hamesha ek sawaal aisa poochho jiska jawab sirf tumhare knowledge source mein ho — isse pata chalega ki grounding kaam kar rahi hai ya agent sirf LLM ki general knowledge se jawab de raha hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.2 Public websites aur web search as knowledge

Agent ko public websites se knowledge de sakte ho — aur web search enable karke real-time information bhi dila sakte ho.

Website ko knowledge source banana

  1. Knowledge tab par jao aur Add Knowledge select karo.
  2. Apni organization ki website ka URL add karo.
  3. Name aur Description edit karo — aisa likho jisse agent samjhe ki ye knowledge source kya hai aur kab use karna hai.
  4. Add select karo.
  5. Test pane mein website ke knowledge par based sawaal poochkar test karo.

Website knowledge ki behavior aur limitations

  • Website ka content crawl karke index hota hai — changes turant reflect nahi hote.
  • URL sirf 2 levels deep tak use kar sakte ho.
  • Public websites hi add kar sakte ho — login ke peeche wali sites nahi.

Web search enable karna

Agent ke Overview tab mein Knowledge section mein Web Search option enable karo aur changes save hone ka wait karo. Phir test pane refresh karo aur aisa sawaal poochho jiska jawab real-time information se chahiye — jaise aaj ki news ya latest update. Web Search setting ko Generative AI settings ke Knowledge section se aur Conversational boosting topic ke properties pane se bhi access kar sakte ho.

Yaad rakhna: Web search se agent ko current information milti hai, lekin us information ki accuracy aur reliability tumhare control mein nahi hoti. Official sources ko hamesha priority do.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.3 Files as knowledge

Documents ko knowledge source bana sakte ho — files upload karke, ya OneDrive/SharePoint se connect karke.

Files upload karna

  1. Knowledge tab par jao aur Add Knowledge select karo.
  2. Apne computer se ek hi subject se related do files select karo.
  3. Group these files option ko On karo — isse files ek group mein rehti hain aur agent unhe ek hi knowledge unit ki tarah treat karta hai.
  4. Name aur Description edit karo — aisa likho jisse agent samjhe ki ye file group kya hai aur kab use karna hai.
  5. Add select karo aur files upload hone ka wait karo.
  6. Test pane refresh karo, phir aisa sawaal poochho jiska jawab tumhari uploaded files mein ho.

OneDrive ya SharePoint files aur folders connect karna

Files ko baar-baar upload karne ke bajaye OneDrive ya SharePoint se connect karo — jab source files update hongi, to agent ko updated knowledge milegi. Connection banate waqt sahi files ya folders select karo, aur unka name/description clear likho.

Connections manage karna

  • Knowledge tab mein saari connections dikhti hain — wahan se edit, refresh ya remove kar sakte ho.
  • File upload hone ke baad wo Dataverse mein upload hokar background mein index hoti hai — badi files mein indexing mein thoda time lag sakta hai; test karne se pehle wait karo.
  • Regularly check karo ki files abhi bhi relevant hain ya nahi — outdated files ko remove karo, warna agent purane answers dega.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.4 SharePoint as knowledge

SharePoint enterprise knowledge ka sabse common source hai — documents, site pages, aur lists. Copilot Studio mein SharePoint ko knowledge source banana straightforward hai.

Tenant graph grounding

Tenant graph grounding ka matlab hai ki agent tumhare Microsoft 365 tenant ke graph (users, files, sites, emails ka connected data) par reason karke answers de. Agar tenant mein Microsoft 365 Copilot license hai, to tenant graph grounding with semantic search agent ke liye enabled ho jati hai — isse answers zyada relevant aur context-aware hote hain.

SharePoint site connect karna

  1. Knowledge tab par jao aur Add knowledge select karo.
  2. Featured list se SharePoint button select karo.
  3. Apni SharePoint site par jao jahan documents document library mein hain ya content main site page par hai. Site ke top level ka URL copy karo.
  4. Copilot Studio mein wapas aakar URL ko Add knowledge configuration screen mein paste karo.
  5. Add select karo.
  6. SharePoint site ka Name aur Description edit karo — taaki agent samjhe ki ye kya hai aur kab use karna hai.
  7. Add button select karo aur wait karo jab tak site connect na ho jaye.

SharePoint List connect karna

Site ke alawa SharePoint List ko bhi knowledge source bana sakte ho — lists mein structured data hota hai (jaise product catalog ya FAQ list), jo agent ke liye bahut useful hota hai.

SharePoint best practices

  • Site-level URL do, individual document URL nahi — taaki poori library index ho.
  • Permissions ka dhyaan rakho — agent sirf wahi content use kar payega jiska access user ke paas hai.
  • Descriptions mein likho ki site mein kis type ka content hai (policies, procedures, product info) taaki orchestrator sahi jagah use kare.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.5 Real-time connectors aur Dataverse tables

Jab data baar-baar badalta ho — jaise orders, tickets, ya inventory — to files ya websites ke bajaye real-time connectors aur Dataverse tables use karo. Agent ko hamesha latest data milta hai.

Enterprise data se real-time connectors se connect karna

Real-time connectors agent ko enterprise systems se live connect karte hain. Connector add karte waqt connection authenticate karni hoti hai aur batana hota hai ki kaunsa data agent use kar sakta hai. Real-time ka matlab hai ki agent har baar fresh data fetch karta hai — stale answers ka risk nahi hota.

Dataverse tables as knowledge source

Dataverse Microsoft Power Platform ka data store hai — tables mein structured data rehta hai. Dataverse table ko knowledge source banane se agent us table ke rows par reason karke answers de sakta hai — jaise “mere open tickets kaunse hain?” ya “is product ka stock kitna hai?”

Dataverse best practices

  • Sirf wahi tables expose karo jo agent ko chahiye — poora database nahi.
  • Table aur columns ki descriptions clear likho — agent ko samajhna chahiye ki har column ka matlab kya hai.
  • Permissions aur security roles check karo — agent user ki permissions ke andar hi data dekh payega.
  • Bade tables mein test karo ki agent sahi rows dhoondh pa raha hai ya nahi.
Kaunsa knowledge source kab?

Static documents → files ya SharePoint. Public info → websites. Real-time data → connectors ya Dataverse. General questions → LLM general knowledge (ya off kar do). Har source ki description mein “kab use karna hai” likhna mat bhoolo.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

06.6 Knowledge best practices

Knowledge add karna aasan hai — lekin sahi knowledge add karna hi agent ki accuracy decide karta hai.

5 best practices

  1. Har source ki clear description likho — name aur description mein likho ki source kya hai aur kab use karna hai. Generative orchestration inhi descriptions se decide karta hai.
  2. Sources ko zyada mat bharo — 4-5 se zyada knowledge sources ya tools hone par performance girne lagti hai; multi-agent design consider karo (Chapter 2, Chapter 9).
  3. Outdated content remove karo — purani files aur websites agent ko galat answers dene par majboor karte hain. Regular audit karo.
  4. Grounding test karo — har source add karne ke baad aisa sawaal poochho jiska jawab sirf us source mein ho. Agar agent sahi source use nahi kar raha, to description sudharo.
  5. General knowledge ko soch-samajhkar on/off karo — agar agent ko sirf business data se jawab dena hai, to general knowledge off kar do; warna agent training data se jawab dega jo tumhare business ke liye galat ho sakta hai.

Content moderation

Copilot Studio mein content moderation built-in hai — lekin tumhare knowledge sources mein jo content hai, uski quality tumhari responsibility hai. Sensitive ya confidential information ko knowledge mein add karne se pehle permissions aur governance check karo.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.1 Topics banana aur edit karna

Topics wo conversations hain jo agent handle karta hai — har topic ka ek trigger hota hai aur uske andar nodes hote hain jo conversation ka flow define karte hain. Topics author karna Copilot Studio ki sabse important skill hai.

Topic banane ke 3 tareeke

  1. Description se: topic ko natural language mein describe karo — jaise “Help users reset their password” — aur Copilot topic ka draft bana deta hai, triggers ke saath.
  2. Blank se: khaali canvas se shuru karo — trigger khud define karo aur nodes khud add karo. Poora control chahiye to ye tareeka best hai.
  3. Code se edit karna: topics ko code (YAML jaisi structure) mein bhi edit kar sakte ho — pro-code makers ke liye, ya bulk changes ke liye.

Topic ka structure

  • Trigger — topic kab start hoga. Classic orchestration mein trigger phrases (5-10); generative mein description se intent match hota hai.
  • Nodes — conversation ke steps: message node, question node, condition, action, etc. Nodes canvas par connect karke flow banate hain.
  • Trigger phrases — classic orchestration mein har topic ke liye 5-10 trigger phrases do, jinse NLU intent samajhta hai. Phrases user ke alag-alag tareekon se poochne ke tareeke cover karne chahiye.
Tip: Topic banane se pehle uska purpose ek line mein likh lo — “Is topic mein user kya karna chahta hai aur agent ko kya outcome dena hai?” Isse trigger aur nodes dono clear ho jate hain.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.2 Message nodes aur adaptive cards

Topic mein user se baat karne ka sabse basic tareeka message node hai — aur use rich banane ke liye adaptive cards hain.

Message node add karna

Canvas par message node add karke usme wo text likho jo agent user ko bhejega. Message mein variables bhi use kar sakte ho — jaise agent ka naam ya user ka naam — jo runtime par fill hote hain.

Message mein image add karna

Message node mein image add karke conversation ko visual banao — jaise product ki photo ya step ka screenshot. Image ka size aur format channel ke hisaab se adjust hota hai.

Cards use karna

Adaptive Cards rich, interactive cards hote hain — inme text, images, buttons aur input fields ho sakte hain. Example: order status dikhane wala card jisme order details aur “Track order” button ho. Kitab ke practice files mein ek AdaptiveCardJSON.json file hai — usme card ka JSON code hai, jise tum topic mein use kar sakte ho.

Message node ki aur features

  • Multiple messages — ek node mein multiple message variations de sakte ho; agent randomly ek chunega, taaki conversation robotic na lage.
  • Speech — voice-enabled agents ke liye message ka spoken version alag se set kar sakte ho.
  • Attachments — message ke saath file ya link bhej sakte ho.
Tip: Har message ko user ki nazar se padho — kya ye clear hai? Kya user ko pata hai ki aage kya karna hai? Agar nahi, to message rewrite karo.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.3 Questions, variables aur entities

Agent ko user se information chahiye hoti hai — wo question nodes se maangta hai, variables mein store karta hai, aur entities se samajhta hai ki user ne kya bola.

Variables samajhna

Variable ek container hai jisme information store hoti hai — jaise user ka naam, order number, ya pasand ki date. Variables topic ke andar ya poore agent mein (global) ho sakte hain. Ek baar value store ho jaye, to use baad ke nodes mein — messages, conditions, actions — kahin bhi use kar sakte ho.

Question node — variables aur conditional logic ke saath

Question node add karke user se sawaal poochho aur answer ko variable mein store karo. Phir condition node se check karo — jaise agar user ne “yes” bola to ek raasta, “no” bola to dusra. Is tarah conversation branch karta hai.

Entities samajhna

Entity ek known data type ya category hai — jaise date, location, product name, ya color. Jab user likhta hai “mujhe kal subah 10 baje ka slot chahiye”, to agent entities se samajhta hai: date = kal, time = 10 baje. Copilot Studio mein out-of-the-box entities hain (age, city, color, country, date, etc.), aur tum apni custom entities bhi bana sakte ho — jaise product name, size, condition.

Yaad rakhna: “Entity” ka ye matlab database schema wale entity se alag hai — wahan entity ka matlab data table hota hai. Yahan entity ka matlab user input se nikala gaya specific information hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.4 PowerFx formulas, logic aur generative answers

Topics mein logic likhne ke liye PowerFx formulas use hote hain — Excel jaisi formula language, jo Microsoft Power Platform mein use hoti hai.

PowerFx formulas use karna

PowerFx se tum values calculate kar sakte ho, text ko format kar sakte ho, conditions check kar sakte ho, aur variables ko transform kar sakte ho — jaise Concatenate() se do strings jodna, ya If() se condition check karna. Formulas ko variables set karne wale nodes mein ya condition nodes mein use karte hain.

Branching logic expand karna

Condition nodes se conversation ko alag-alag branches mein divide karo — har branch ek alag outcome handle karta hai. Branching ko zyada deep mat banao — agar branches bahut zyada ho jayein, to topic ko chhote topics mein tod do.

Slot filling aur skip behavior

Slot filling wo process hai jisme agent action lene se pehle saari zaroori information collect karta hai. Classic orchestration mein tumhe har information ke liye alag question node banana padta hai. Generative orchestration mein LLM khud samajhta hai ki kaunsi information missing hai aur follow-up questions poochta hai. Skip behavior configure kar sakte ho — agar user ne information pehle hi de di hai, to agent wo sawaal skip kar dega.

Topic mein knowledge add karna

Topic ke andar bhi knowledge add kar sakte ho — generative answers node se. Isse topic specific knowledge se answer bana sakta hai, bina poore agent ke knowledge ko involve kiye. Ye tab useful hai jab ek topic ko kisi specific document ya website se answer chahiye.

PowerFx seekhne ka shortcut

PowerFx Excel formulas jaisi hai — agar tum Excel formulas jaante ho, to PowerFx bahut jaldi seekh jaoge. If, Concatenate, Text, Value jaise functions se shuru karo.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.5 Topic transitions aur internal triggers

Topics akele nahi chalte — ek topic se dusre topic par jana (redirect), conversation khatam karna, aur system topics ko samajhna bhi zaroori hai.

Redirect aur end karna

  • Redirect: ek topic ke end mein dusre topic par redirect kar sakte ho — jaise password reset topic complete hone ke baad feedback topic par jana.
  • End topic: topic khatam karke conversation ko wapas main flow mein la sakte ho, ya conversation end kar sakte ho.
  • End conversation: jab kaam complete ho jaye, to conversation end karo aur user ko summary ya next steps batao.

Topic triggers

Har topic ka trigger hota hai — classic mein trigger phrases, generative mein description. Trigger tab fire hota hai jab user ka input us topic ke intent se match karta hai. Trigger phrases likhte waqt user ke alag-alag bolne ke tareeke cover karo — 5-10 phrases do, synonyms aur variations ke saath.

System topics

Copilot Studio mein kuch system topics pehle se hote hain, jo automatically generate hote hain:

  • Conversation Start — greeting message (Chapter 4 mein edit karna seekha).
  • Conversational boosting — unknown intent par generative answers se jawab deta hai.
  • End of Conversation — conversation khatam hone par chalta hai (jaise survey ya goodbye message).
  • Escalation — human ko handoff karne ke liye.
  • Fallback — jab kuch match na ho.

System topics ko edit kar sakte ho, lekin delete mat karo — ye agent ke basic behavior ke liye zaroori hain.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

07.6 Topics likhne ki best practices

Acche topics likhna ek skill hai — ye 5 practices yaad rakho.

  1. Ek topic, ek kaam: har topic sirf ek hi intent handle kare. Agar topic bahut bada ho raha hai, to use chhote topics mein tod do.
  2. Trigger phrases user ki bhasha mein likho: user kaise bolega, waise phrases do — formal language nahi, natural language.
  3. Descriptions clear rakho: generative orchestration mein topic ki description hi trigger ka kaam karti hai — vague description se galat topic trigger hoga.
  4. Har path ko test karo: topic ke har branch ko test karo — happy path ke saath-saath “no” wale answers aur unexpected inputs bhi.
  5. Messages chhote aur clear rakho: ek message mein ek hi baat kaho. Lambi messages user padhta nahi — chhote messages aur cards use karo.

Skills review — Chapter 7

Is chapter ke baad tum: topics description, blank aur code se bana sakte ho; message nodes aur adaptive cards use kar sakte ho; questions, variables aur entities ke saath kaam kar sakte ho; PowerFx formulas aur branching logic likh sakte ho; aur topic transitions aur system topics manage kar sakte ho.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

08.1 Connectors aur REST APIs as tools

Agent sirf jawab nahi deta — tools se wo actions bhi leta hai. Sabse common tools hain connectors aur REST APIs.

Connector as a tool add karna

Connector ek prebuilt integration hai jo agent ko kisi system se connect karta hai — jaise Outlook, SharePoint, Salesforce, ya ServiceNow. Connector add karte waqt:

  1. Tool add karne ke option mein connector chuno.
  2. Connection authenticate karo — apne account se sign in karke permission do.
  3. Kaunsi actions agent use kar sakta hai, wo select karo — jaise email bhejna, record banana, ya data fetch karna.
  4. Tool ki description clear likho — generative orchestration isi se decide karega ki ye tool kab use karna hai.
  5. Test pane mein test karo — agent se kaho ki wo action kare aur dekho ki sahi hota hai ya nahi.

REST API se tool banana

Agar koi prebuilt connector nahi hai, to REST API se tool banao:

  • API ka endpoint, method (GET/POST), aur parameters define karo.
  • Authentication set karo (API key, OAuth, ya basic auth).
  • Request aur response ka schema batayo — agent ko samajhna chahiye ki input kya dena hai aur output kya milega.
  • Test karke verify karo ki API call sahi kaam kar rahi hai.
Tip: Tool ki description mein ye likho: ye tool kya karta hai, kab use karna hai, aur kya input chahiye. Vague description se agent tool ko galat jagah ya galat tareeke se use karega.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

08.2 Agent flows banana

Agent flows (Power Automate flows) wo deterministic workflows hain jo agent ke liye actions karte hain — jaise approval lena, record banana, ya multiple systems mein data update karna.

Stand-alone agent flow banana

Stand-alone flow agent se independent hota hai — use Power Automate mein banao, phir agent mein tool ki tarah add karo. Flow mein triggers, actions aur conditions hote hain — jaise “jab flow chale, to pehle record nikalo, phir approval bhejo, phir status update karo.”

Agent se triggered flow banana

Agent-triggered flow tab chalta hai jab agent use call karta hai — conversation ke beech mein. Example: user kehte hain “mera leave request submit karo” — agent flow ko trigger karta hai, flow HR system mein request submit karta hai, aur result agent ko wapas deta hai jo user ko batata hai.

Flow ko agent se connect karna

  1. Flow banao aur test karo — pehle Power Automate mein hi verify kar lo ki flow sahi kaam karta hai.
  2. Agent mein tool add karo aur flow select karo.
  3. Flow ke inputs aur outputs ko agent ke variables se map karo.
  4. Description likho aur test pane mein end-to-end test karo.
Yaad rakhna: Flows deterministic hote hain — jo parts fixed aur structured rehne chahiye (approvals, transactions, compliance steps), unke liye flows best hain. Reasoning wale parts generative AI ko do.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

08.3 Topic mein tools add karna

Tools sirf agent level par nahi — topic level par bhi add kar sakte ho. Isse tool sirf us topic ke andar use hota hai, poore agent mein nahi.

Kab topic-level tool use karein

  • Jab tool sirf ek specific conversation ke liye ho — jaise password reset topic mein sirf password reset API.
  • Jab tum chahte ho ki tool sirf tab call ho jab wo topic trigger ho — isse galat jagah tool call hone ka risk kam hota hai.
  • Jab topic ka flow deterministic ho — question → tool call → result message.

Topic mein tool add karne ke steps

  1. Topic authoring canvas kholo.
  2. Jis jagah tool call karna hai, wahan Call an action ya tool node add karo.
  3. Tool select karo (connector, flow, REST API, ya prompt).
  4. Tool ke inputs ko topic ke variables se map karo.
  5. Tool ka output ek variable mein store karo — phir use message node ya condition mein use karo.
  6. Test karo — topic ko trigger karke dekho ki tool sahi call ho raha hai aur output sahi aa raha hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

08.4 Prompt as a tool

Ek prompt ko bhi tool ki tarah use kar sakte ho — prompt ek reusable instruction hoti hai jo LLM ko ek specific kaam karne ko kehti hai, jaise text summarize karna ya email draft karna.

Prompt tool kaise kaam karta hai

  • Prompt mein instruction likho — jaise “Is ticket description ko 2 lines mein summarize karo.”
  • Input variables define karo — prompt ko kya data milega.
  • Output ko variable mein store karo — phir use conversation mein aage use karo.
  • Prompt ke liye alag model bhi select kar sakte ho (Chapter 13 mein detail hai).

Kab prompt tool use karein

  • Jab kaam text transformation ka ho — summarize, translate, rephrase, draft.
  • Jab tum chahte ho ki ek specific step mein LLM ka behavior tightly controlled ho.
  • Jab ek hi prompt ko multiple topics mein reuse karna ho.
Tip: Prompt tools ko naam aur description aise do ki pata chale wo kya karta hai — jaise “Summarize ticket” ya “Draft reply email”. Yehi description orchestrator ko guide karti hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

08.5 MCP server se tools add karna

Model Context Protocol (MCP) ek open standard hai jisse agents external servers se tools le sakte hain. MCP server par available tools ko tum apne agent mein add kar sakte ho — bina har tool ko khud banaye.

MCP server se tool add karna

  1. MCP server ka URL aur connection details lo.
  2. Agent mein tool add karne ke option mein MCP server select karo.
  3. Server connect karo — available tools ki list dikhegi.
  4. Jo tools chahiye, unhe select karo aur unki descriptions review karo.
  5. Test pane mein test karo ki tools sahi call ho rahe hain.

MCP kyun important hai

  • Standardization: har vendor ko alag integration banane ki zaroorat nahi — MCP ek common protocol hai.
  • Discovery: server par naye tools aane par agent use discover kar sakta hai.
  • Ecosystem: MCP servers ki growing library se tools milte hain — jaise file systems, databases, aur third-party apps.
Tools ka golden rule

Har tool ki description clear likho, sirf zaroori tools add karo, aur har tool ko test karo. Tools zyada hone se agent confuse hota hai — 4-5 se zyada tools hone par multi-agent design consider karo.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

09.1 Multi-agent orchestration samajhna

Jab ek agent se kaam na bane, to multi-agent system banao — har agent ek domain mein specialist, aur zaroorat par ek dusre ko handoff.

Kab multi-agent use karein

  • Jab agent ko 4-5 se zyada knowledge sources ya tools chahiye — single agent ki performance girne lagti hai.
  • Jab domains clearly alag hon — jaise banking mein personal loans, mortgages, business banking.
  • Jab alag teams alag agents own karti hon — har team apna agent maintain kare.

Child agents vs connected agents

Child agentsConnected agents
Kya haiEk hi agent ke andar banaye gaye sub-agentsDusre existing agents se connection
Kab use kareinJab tum khud saare agents design kar rahe hoJab agent pehle se bana hua ho (tumhara ya kisi aur ka)
ControlPoora control — ek hi jagah manage hota haiHar agent apne owner ke paas rehta hai

Multi-agent design mein ek orchestrator agent hota hai jo user se baat karta hai aur decide karta hai ki kaunsa specialist agent bulana hai. Specialist agent apna kaam karke result wapas deta hai, aur orchestrator user ko consolidated answer deta hai.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

09.2 Child agents banana aur use karna

Child agents ek hi agent ke andar banaye gaye sub-agents hain — har child ek specific process ya domain mein specialist hota hai.

Child agent banane ke steps

  1. Parent agent kholo aur multi-agent section mein jao.
  2. Add child agent select karo.
  3. Child agent ka naam, description aur instructions likho — description mein clearly likho ki ye child kis kaam ke liye hai aur kab bulana hai.
  4. Child ko uski knowledge sources aur tools do — sirf uske domain se related.
  5. Parent agent ki instructions mein likho ki kab kis child ko call karna hai.
  6. Test karo — parent se aisa sawaal poochho jo child ke domain ka ho, aur activity map mein dekho ki sahi child call hua ya nahi.

Child agents ke design rules

  • Har child ka scope tight rakho — ek child, ek domain.
  • Child ki description mein trigger conditions likho — “jab user loan ke baare mein poochhe, to loan agent ko bulao.”
  • Child agents ke beech mein circular handoff mat banao (A → B → A) — infinite loop ho jayega.
  • Child ka output parent ko wapas aana chahiye — user ko seedha child se baat nahi karni chahiye.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

09.3 Existing agents se connect karna

Naya agent banane ke bajaye tum apne agent ko existing agents se connect kar sakte ho — chahe wo Copilot Studio agents hon ya bahar ke agents.

Copilot Studio agent se connect karna

  1. Agent mein connected agents ka option kholo.
  2. Us Copilot Studio agent ko select karo jisse connect karna hai.
  3. Connection ke liye description likho — ye agent kab use hoga aur kis kaam ke liye.
  4. Permissions check karo — connected agent ke knowledge aur tools ka access sahi hai ya nahi.
  5. Test karo — aisa sawaal poochho jo connected agent ke domain ka ho.

Dusre existing agents se connect karna

Copilot Studio ke bahar ke agents (jaise Azure AI Foundry mein bane agents ya third-party agents) se bhi connect kar sakte ho — connectors ya MCP ke through. Connection banate waqt authentication aur data sharing ke rules check karo — sensitive data share karne se pehle governance approval lo.

Tip: Connected agents ka fayda ye hai ki har team apna agent independently maintain kar sakti hai — ek agent update ho, to dusre agents ko dobara build nahi karna padta.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

09.4 Multi-agent design best practices

Multi-agent systems powerful hote hain, lekin design galat ho to wo slow aur confusing ho jate hain. Ye practices yaad rakho.

  1. Orchestrator ko smart rakho: orchestrator agent ki instructions mein clearly likho ki kaunsa specialist kab bulana hai. Agar orchestrator confuse hoga, to galat agent call hoga.
  2. Specialists ko narrow rakho: har specialist ka domain tight rakho — ek agent sab kuch karega, to wapas single-agent problem aa jayegi.
  3. Handoff mein context pass karo: jab ek agent dusre ko handoff kare, to conversation ka context (user ne kya bola, kya pata chala) saath bhejo — user ko dobara wahi baat nahi bolni chahiye.
  4. Loops se bacho: A → B → A circular handoffs mat banao. Har handoff ka ek clear end hona chahiye.
  5. Har agent ko alag test karo: pehle har specialist ko alag test karo, phir orchestrator ke saath end-to-end test karo.
  6. Monitoring alag rakho: har agent ki performance alag monitor karo — kaunsa agent zyada use ho raha hai, kahan fail ho raha hai (Chapter 11).

Skills review — Chapter 9

Is chapter ke baad tum: multi-agent orchestration kab use karna hai, ye decide kar sakte ho; child agents bana aur use kar sakte ho; aur existing agents (Copilot Studio aur bahar ke) se connect kar sakte ho.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

10.1 Agent authentication method chunna

Agent publish karne se pehle decide karo ki users authenticate kaise honge — kyunki authentication se decide hota hai ki agent user ke baare mein kya jaan sakta hai aur kin systems tak pahunch sakta hai.

Authentication ke options

  • No authentication (anonymous): koi bhi user bina sign in kiye agent use kar sakta hai. Public websites par customer self-service ke liye suitable hai — lekin agent user-specific data access nahi kar sakta.
  • Microsoft Entra ID authentication: user apne work/school account se sign in karta hai. Agent ko pata hota hai ki user kaun hai — isse personalized answers aur user-specific data access possible hota hai. Internal agents ke liye best hai.
  • Custom authentication: third-party identity provider se authentication — jab users Microsoft accounts use nahi karte.

Kya dhyaan mein rakhein

  • Authentication method agent banane ke baad bhi badal sakte ho, lekin pehle se decide karna behtar hai — kyunki tools aur knowledge permissions usi par depend karte hain.
  • External agents mein authentication halka rakho (friction kam ho), internal agents mein strong rakho (security zyada ho).
  • Tools jo user ke behalf par actions lete hain (jaise email bhejna), unke liye authentication zaroori hai — bina auth ke agent user ke naam par action nahi le sakta.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

10.2 Agent publish aur test karna

Agent ko publish karna use live karna hai — lekin publish karne se pehle test karna mat bhoolo.

Publish karne se pehle test karo

  1. Test pane mein saare main scenarios test karo — happy path, edge cases, aur failure cases.
  2. Har knowledge source se answer verify karo — agent sahi source use kar raha hai ya nahi, activity map mein dekho.
  3. Tools ko test karo — har tool call sahi ho rahi hai aur output sahi aa raha hai ya nahi.
  4. Fallback aur escalation test karo — jab agent answer na jaane, to kya hota hai?

Publish karne ke steps

  1. Agent configuration screen par Publish select karo.
  2. Publish hone ka wait karo — agent ab live hai.
  3. Publish ke baad agent ko uske channel par jaakar test karo (sirf test pane mein nahi) — real channel par behavior thoda alag ho sakta hai.
  4. Changes karne ke baad dobara publish karna padta hai — test pane mein changes dikhenge, lekin live agent tabhi update hoga jab tum publish karoge.
IMPORTANT: Publish karna aur save karna alag cheezein hain. Save karne se changes draft mein rehte hain; publish karne se hi wo live users tak pahunchte hain. Agar tumne edit kiya lekin publish nahi kiya, to users ko purana version hi dikhega.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

10.3 Channels choose aur configure karna

Publish karne ke baad agent ko channels par lagana hota hai — channel wo jagah hai jahan users agent se milte hain.

Internal channels

  • Microsoft 365 Copilot: agent ko Microsoft 365 Copilot ke andar publish karo — users Copilot Chat mein use kar sakte hain. (Extend karne wala scenario.)
  • Microsoft Teams: Teams app ke roop mein agent publish karo — team channels ya personal chat mein use ho.
  • Internal websites/apps: company ki internal site ya app mein embed karo.

External channels

  • Public website: customer-facing website par chat widget lagao.
  • Mobile apps: company ke mobile app mein agent embed karo.
  • Social media: Facebook Messenger jaise channels par publish karo.

Channel configure karte waqt

  • Har channel ke liye authentication aur branding alag set kar sakte ho.
  • Channel ke hisaab se message formatting badalti hai — adaptive cards kuch channels par achhe dikhte hain, kuch par nahi.
  • Ek agent ko multiple channels par publish kar sakte ho — build once, publish everywhere.
Tip: Pehle ek channel par publish karke test karo, phir dheere-dheere dusre channels add karo. Har channel par user behavior alag hota hai — monitoring se seekho ki kahan kya improve karna hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

10.4 Publish checklist

Publish dabane se pehle is checklist se guzro — ek bhi point miss hua to live users ko problem hogi.

  1. Authentication set hai? Internal hai ya external, us hisaab se sahi method chuna hai?
  2. Instructions aur descriptions final hain? Koi placeholder text to nahi reh gaya?
  3. Knowledge sources sahi hain? Outdated files ya websites to nahi hain?
  4. Tools test kiye? Har tool end-to-end test kiya hai?
  5. Fallback aur escalation configured hai? Agent jab na jaane to kya karega, aur human ko kab handoff karega?
  6. Greeting message brand voice mein hai? Conversation Start topic edit kiya?
  7. Channels decide kiye? Pehle kaunse channel par publish karna hai?
  8. Monitoring ready hai? Publish ke baad activity aur transcripts kaise dekhoge, pata hai?
  9. Rollback plan hai? Agar kuch galat ho, to agent ko kaise wapas loge ya band karoge?
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

11.1 Conversational agent performance analyse karna

Agent publish karne ke baad kaam khatam nahi hota — monitoring se pata chalta hai ki agent asal mein kaise perform kar raha hai.

Conversational agent metrics samajhna

Copilot Studio mein analytics dashboard hota hai jisme ye metrics dikhte hain:

  • Sessions: kitne conversations hue, kab hue, kis channel par hue.
  • Resolution rate: kitne sessions mein user ko answer mila (resolved) vs kitne escalate hue ya unresolved rahe.
  • Engagement: users kitni der baat karte hain, kitne turns lete hain.
  • Top topics: kaunse topics sabse zyada trigger hote hain — aur kaunse kabhi trigger nahi hote.
  • Fallback rate: kitni baar Conversational boosting ya fallback use hua — zyada fallback rate ka matlab hai ki topics ya knowledge mein gap hai.
  • CSAT (customer satisfaction): users agent se kitne satisfied hain.

Metrics se kya seekhein

  • Zyada fallback rate → naye topics banao ya knowledge sources improve karo.
  • Kuch topics kabhi trigger nahi hote → trigger phrases ya descriptions sudharo.
  • Escalation zyada hai → agent ki capability badhao ya escalation criteria review karo.
  • Ek hi sawaal baar-baar aata hai → uske liye dedicated topic ya suggested prompt banao.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

11.2 Conversation transcripts download karna

Metrics se “kya” pata chalta hai, transcripts se “kyun” pata chalta hai. Transcripts padhkar tum dekh sakte ho ki agent ne exactly kya bola aur user ne kya poochha.

Copilot Studio se sessions download karna

  1. Analytics ya Sessions section mein jao.
  2. Woh sessions chuno jise review karna hai — jaise failed ya escalated sessions.
  3. Session kholkar poori conversation padho — user ke inputs, agent ke responses, kaunse topics trigger hue, kaunse tools call hue.
  4. Download karke offline analysis bhi kar sakte ho.

Dataverse se sessions download karna

Conversation sessions Dataverse mein bhi store hote hain — wahan se tum bulk mein sessions download karke analysis kar sakte ho, jaise Excel mein ya Power BI mein. Ye tab useful hai jab tumhe bade scale par patterns dhoondhne hon.

Transcripts review karne ke rules

  • Privacy ka dhyaan rakho — transcripts mein user ki personal information ho sakti hai; sirf authorized log hi dekhein.
  • Har hafte kuch failed sessions padho — wahi se sabse zyada seekhne ko milta hai.
  • Patterns note karo — ek hi galti baar-baar ho rahi hai to uska root cause fix karo (instructions, knowledge, ya topic).
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

11.3 Autonomous agent performance analyse karna

Autonomous agents ke liye monitoring aur bhi important hai — kyunki wo bina human ke actions lete hain, to galti ka impact zyada hota hai.

Autonomous agent metrics samajhna

  • Runs: agent kitni baar chala — successful, failed, aur partially successful runs.
  • Decisions: agent ne kaunse decisions liye — accept, flag, reject, ya escalate.
  • Human interventions: kitni baar human ko involve hona pada — aur kya wo sahi jagah thi.
  • Time to complete: har run mein kitna time laga.
  • Tool usage: kaunse tools kitni baar call hue — aur kahan fail hue.

Activity review

Har run ki activity review karo — agent ne kaunse knowledge sources use kiye, kaunse tools call kiye, aur decisions kaise liye. Agar agent ne galat decision li, to instructions ya knowledge mein kya sudharna hai, wo activity se pata chalega.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

11.4 Improve karne ka loop

Monitoring ka maksad report banana nahi — improve karna hai. Ye loop har hafte chalao.

  1. Measure karo: metrics dekho — resolution rate, fallback rate, escalations.
  2. Review karo: failed aur escalated sessions ke transcripts padho.
  3. Root cause dhoondho: problem instructions mein hai, knowledge mein, topic mein, ya tool mein?
  4. Fix karo: ek baar mein ek change karo — phir test karo.
  5. Publish karo: fix ko publish karo aur phir se measure karo.
Agent kabhi “complete” nahi hota

Agent ek living system hai — business badalta hai, users ke sawaal badalte hain, data badalta hai. Jo agent aaj perfect hai, wo 3 mahine baad outdated ho sakta hai. Isliye monitoring aur improvement ka loop kabhi band mat karo.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

12.1 Voice-enabled agent banana

Chat ke alawa agent voice se bhi baat kar sakta hai — phone par ya voice channel par. Voice-enabled agent banana chat agent jaisa hi hai, lekin kuch extra settings hoti hain.

Voice-enabled agent ki capabilities aur settings

  • Agent user ki awaaz sunta hai (speech-to-text), jawab sochta hai, aur bolkar jawab deta hai (text-to-speech).
  • Voice settings mein awaaz (voice), speed, aur barge-in behavior configure karte hain — barge-in ka matlab hai ki user agent ke bolte waqt beech mein bolkar use rok sakta hai ya nahi.
  • Voice agents mein messages chhote hone chahiye — lambi messages sunna mushkil hota hai.
  • Voice ke liye alag greeting aur prompts likho — jo likhne mein achha lage, wo bolne mein awkward ho sakta hai.

Voice agent banane ke steps

  1. Agent banao ya existing agent kholo.
  2. Voice settings enable karo aur voice select karo.
  3. Topics ko voice ke hisaab se adjust karo — messages chhote karo, aur speech version alag se set karo.
  4. Knowledge ko voice ke hisaab se test karo — voice mein sawaal poochhne ka tareeka chat se alag hota hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

12.2 Voice ke liye topics configure karna aur knowledge use karna

Voice agents mein topics aur knowledge thoda alag tareeke se kaam karte hain — kyunki user bolta hai, type nahi karta.

Voice ke liye topics configure karna

  • Trigger phrases spoken language mein likho — user bolega kaise, waise phrases do. Likhi hui bhasha aur boli hui bhasha mein farak hota hai.
  • Messages chhote rakho — voice mein 2-3 sentences se zyada ek baar mein mat bolo.
  • Confirmations use karo — important information (jaise order number ya amount) ko dobara bolkar confirm karo.
  • Speech version alag se set karo — message node mein likha text aur bola jaane wala text alag ho sakte hain.

Voice agents mein knowledge use karna

Knowledge sources voice mein bhi waise hi kaam karte hain — lekin generative answers chhote hone chahiye. Lambi answers ko summarize karke bolo, aur details ke liye user ko SMS ya email bhej do. Agar answer lamba hai, to agent keh sakta hai: “Main aapko details SMS par bhej deta hoon.”

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

12.3 Chat se voice agent test karna

Voice agent ko test karne ke liye har baar phone uthane ki zaroorat nahi — chat se test karke bhi voice behavior verify kar sakte ho.

Chat se test karne ke steps

  1. Test pane mein agent se waise sawaal poochho jaise user phone par poochhega — spoken style mein.
  2. Agent ke answers ko zor se padhkar dekho — kya ye bolne mein natural lagta hai? Kya sentences bahut lambe hain?
  3. Speech version check karo — jo text bola jayega, wo message node ke text se alag hai ya nahi.
  4. Barge-in aur interruption scenarios test karo — agar user beech mein bole to kya hota hai.

Asli voice test

Chat test ke baad ek baar asli voice channel par bhi test karo — phone se call karke. Real voice mein background noise, accents, aur network delays aate hain jo chat test mein nahi dikhte.

Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

12.4 Customer engagement channel par publish aur escalation

Voice agent ko customer engagement channel (jaise contact center) par publish karke customers se connect karo — aur jab agent solve na kar paye, to human agent ko escalate karo.

Publish karne ke steps

  1. Voice agent ko test karke publish karo (Chapter 10 wala process).
  2. Customer engagement channel select karo aur configure karo — jaise phone number ya chat widget.
  3. Channel ke liye voice settings aur greeting final karo.
  4. Live test karo — real call karke dekho ki agent sahi kaam kar raha hai ya nahi.

Escalation configure karna

  • Kab escalate karna hai: jab agent answer na jaane, jab user human se baat karna chahe (“agent se baat karo”), ya jab issue sensitive ho (jaise refund ya complaint).
  • Kisko escalate karna hai: sahi team ya queue select karo — jaise billing team ya technical support.
  • Kya information bhejni hai: conversation ka context, user ki details, aur ab tak kya hua — sab human agent ko saath bhejo, taaki user ko dobara sab nahi bolna pade.
  • Escalation topic: Copilot Studio mein escalation system topic hota hai — use customize karke apne escalation flow ke hisaab se set karo.
Tip: Escalation failure nahi hai — ye design ka hissa hai. Best agents bhi kuch cases mein escalate karte hain. Escalation ko smooth banao, aur escalation ke baad kya hua, use bhi monitor karo.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

13.1 Azure AI Search mein vector index banana

Jab tumhare paas bahut saara data ho aur semantic search chahiye ho, to Azure AI Search mein vector index banao — phir use Copilot Studio agent ke knowledge source ki tarah use karo.

Azure prerequisites review/set up karna

  • Azure subscription aur Azure AI Search service chahiye.
  • Data source taiyar rakho — jaise documents ka collection ya database.
  • Permissions check karo — Copilot Studio ko Azure AI Search access karne ki permission chahiye hogi.

Data import aur vectorize karna

  1. Azure AI Search mein naya index banao.
  2. Data source connect karo aur documents import karo.
  3. Documents ko vectorize karo — matlab har document ko numbers (vectors) mein convert karo, taaki semantic search kaam kare. Vectorization ke liye embedding model use hota hai.
  4. Index banne ka wait karo — bade data mein time lag sakta hai.
  5. Search ko test karo — kuch queries daalkar dekho ki relevant documents aa rahe hain ya nahi.
Vector search kya hai: Normal keyword search sirf exact words match karta hai. Vector search meaning match karta hai — user ne “laptop charge nahi ho raha” likha, to wo “battery issue” wale documents bhi dhoondh lega, kyunki meaning similar hai. Isi liye RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) mein vector search use hota hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

13.2 Azure AI Search as knowledge source

Vector index banne ke baad use agent ke knowledge source ki tarah add karo — phir agent tumhare data par semantic search karke answers dega.

Add karne ke steps

  1. Agent ke Knowledge tab mein jao aur Add Knowledge select karo.
  2. Azure AI Search select karo.
  3. Apna search service aur index select karo.
  4. Connection authenticate karo.
  5. Name aur description likho — kya data hai aur kab use karna hai.
  6. Test karo — aisa sawaal poochho jiska jawab sirf is index mein ho.

Kab Azure AI Search use karein

  • Jab data bahut bada ho (thousands of documents) aur keyword search kaafi na ho.
  • Jab semantic search chahiye ho — meaning-based matching.
  • Jab data baar-baar update hota ho — index ko refresh karke agent ko latest data do.
  • Jab tumhe search par zyada control chahiye ho — jaise filters, ranking, aur scoring.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

13.3 Apna Azure AI Foundry model laana

Copilot Studio ke default models ke bajaye tum apna Azure AI Foundry model bhi la sakte ho — jaise fine-tuned model ya industry-specific model.

Teen jagah model select karte hain

  1. Primary model: agent ki main reasoning aur orchestration ke liye kaunsa model use hoga. Ye agent ki “brain” hai.
  2. Response model: generative answers ke liye kaunsa model use hoga — answers ki quality aur style is par depend karti hai.
  3. Prompt tool ka model: prompt tools ke liye kaunsa model use hoga — har prompt tool ke liye alag model select kar sakte ho.

Apna model laane ke steps

  1. Azure AI Foundry mein model taiyar karo — fine-tune karo ya catalog se select karo.
  2. Model ko deploy karo aur endpoint lo.
  3. Copilot Studio mein model settings mein jao aur Bring your own model select karo.
  4. Endpoint aur credentials add karo.
  5. Primary, response, ya prompt model ke roop mein select karo.
  6. Test karo — naye model se answers kaise badalte hain, dekho.
Tip: Custom model sirf tab lao jab default model se kaam na bane — jaise industry-specific terminology, ya compliance requirements. Custom model ki cost aur maintenance bhi zyada hoti hai.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

13.4 Azure integration best practices

Azure ke saath integration powerful hai, lekin kuch best practices follow karo.

  1. Index ko fresh rakho: Azure AI Search index ko regularly refresh karo — warna agent purane data se jawab dega.
  2. Embeddings ka model consistent rakho: index banate waqt jo embedding model use kiya, query karte waqt wahi use karo — alag model se results kharab honge.
  3. Cost monitor karo: Azure AI Search aur Foundry models ki cost alag se aati hai — Copilot Studio ke message costs ke alawa. Dono ko mila kar calculate karo.
  4. Permissions tight rakho: Agent ko sirf wahi data access do jo use chahiye — poora Azure subscription nahi.
  5. Test with real queries: Real user queries se test karo — synthetic test data se asli performance nahi pata chalti.

Skills review — Chapter 13

Is chapter ke baad tum: Azure AI Search mein vector index bana sakte ho; use knowledge source ki tarah add kar sakte ho; aur Azure AI Foundry se apna model laakar primary, response ya prompt model ke roop mein use kar sakte ho.

A.1 IT helpdesk agent banana — poora project

Is appendix mein tum kitab ki saari seekh ek poore end-to-end project mein lagate ho — ek IT helpdesk agent banana, jo employees ki IT problems solve karta hai.

Agent ka purpose

IT helpdesk agent employees ke common IT issues handle karta hai — jaise password reset, software install requests, VPN problems, aur ticket status check. Agent internal hai aur Microsoft Teams par publish hoga.

Design decisions

  • Type: Conversational agent — employees chat mein sawaal poochte hain.
  • Orchestration: Generative — kyunki issues varied hote hain aur reasoning chahiye.
  • Knowledge: IT policy documents (SharePoint), FAQ files, aur internal knowledge base website.
  • Tools: Ticket system connector (ticket banana aur status check karna), password reset flow.
  • Topics: Password reset, software request, VPN help, ticket status, escalation.
  • Fallback/escalation: Agent solve na kar paye to IT support team ko escalate karo — conversation context ke saath.

Banane ke steps (summary)

  1. Development environment mein agent banao — naam aur icon set karo.
  2. Description aur instructions likho — tone helpful aur concise rakho.
  3. Knowledge add karo — SharePoint IT docs, FAQ files, knowledge base website.
  4. Topics banao — har common issue ke liye ek topic, trigger phrases ke saath.
  5. Tools add karo — ticket connector aur password reset flow.
  6. Conversation Start topic ka greeting edit karo.
  7. Test karo — har topic ko test karo, phir publish karo Teams par.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

A.2 Helpdesk agent test karna aur improve karna

Helpdesk agent banne ke baad use real scenarios se test karo aur improve karo.

Test scenarios

  • “Mera password reset karo” — password reset topic trigger hona chahiye.
  • “Mujhe VPN connect nahi ho raha” — VPN help topic aur relevant knowledge use hona chahiye.
  • “Mere ticket ka status kya hai?” — ticket connector se live status aana chahiye.
  • “Mujhe Photoshop install karna hai” — software request topic aur approval flow trigger hona chahiye.
  • “Mera laptop screen flicker kar raha hai” — aisa issue jo agent solve na kar paye — escalation hona chahiye.

Improve karna

  • Failed sessions ke transcripts padho — kahan agent atak raha hai?
  • Trigger phrases add karo jo users ne actually use kiye.
  • Knowledge update karo — nayi policies aur FAQs add karo.
  • Resolution rate monitor karo — Chapter 11 wala loop chalao.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

B.1 Customer support agent banana — poora project

Dusra end-to-end project ek customer support agent hai — jo customers ko website par self-service deta hai, 24x7.

Agent ka purpose

Customer support agent customers ke sawaalon ke jawab deta hai aur common tasks karta hai — jaise order status check karna, returns process karna, aur product compare karna. Agent external hai aur public website par publish hoga.

Design decisions

  • Type: Conversational agent — customers chat mein aate hain.
  • Orchestration: Generative — varied questions aur reasoning ke liye.
  • Knowledge: Product website, FAQ documents, returns policy.
  • Tools: Order system connector (order status nikalna), returns flow, product comparison.
  • Topics: Order status, returns, product comparison, delivery info, escalation.
  • Authentication: Anonymous (public website) — lekin order status ke liye order number maangta hai.
  • Escalation: Complex issues par human support team ko handoff — order details aur conversation context ke saath.

Banane ke steps (summary)

  1. Development environment mein agent banao.
  2. Instructions mein tone friendly aur clear rakho — non-technical customers ke liye.
  3. Knowledge add karo — product website (2 levels deep URL), FAQ files, returns policy.
  4. Topics banao — order status, returns (intent + entities: product, size, location, condition), product comparison.
  5. Tools add karo — order connector aur returns flow.
  6. Website channel par publish karo aur live test karo.
Source: Pearson Education — Microsoft Copilot Studio Step by Step · Companion page: https://www.microsoftpressstore.com/copilotstudio

B.2 Support agent test karna aur improve karna

Customer support agent ko real customer language se test karo — customers waise nahi bolte jaise tum sochte ho.

Test scenarios

  • “Mera order kahan hai?” — order status topic aur connector test hota hai.
  • “Mujhe ye jacket return karni hai” — returns topic: intent + entities (product, size, location, condition) nikalne chahiye; slot filling se missing info poochni chahiye.
  • “Surface Pro aur Surface Laptop mein kya farak hai?” — product comparison, website knowledge se answer aana chahiye.
  • “Delivery kab hogi?” — delivery info topic.
  • “Mujhe human se baat karni hai” — escalation trigger hona chahiye.

Improve karna

  • Returns wale conversations ke transcripts padho — slot filling sahi kaam kar raha hai ya nahi?
  • Trigger phrases mein customer ki actual language add karo.
  • CSAT monitor karo — customers agent se satisfied hain ya nahi.
  • Internal agent se external agent tak ka pattern yaad rakho — pehle internal team ke liye banao, test karo, phir customer-facing banao.
Kitab khatam — ab tumhari baari

13 chapters aur 2 appendices ke baad tumhare paas poora toolkit hai — design, build, ground, extend, publish, monitor. Ab apna agent banao: ek chhota use case chuno, Playground Agent se shuru karo, aur iterate karte raho.

Labs — haath se try karo

8 interactive labs. Har lab mein khud try karo — agent type chunna, orchestration simulate karna, cost estimate karna, PowerFx chalana aur bhi.

Lab 1 · Agent Type Chooser

Scenario padho aur sahi agent type chuno — conversational, autonomous, ya multi-agent. Har scenario ka sahi jawab book ke rules se aata hai (Chapter 1 aur 9).

Scenario 1: Company ke employees password reset aur VPN help ke liye chat karna chahte hain. Kaunsa agent type?

Scenario 2: Agent ko har subah 9 baje supplier invoices validate karne hain, discrepancies flag karni hain, aur sirf badi discrepancies par human ko ping karna hai. Kaunsa agent type?

Scenario 3: Banking agent ko loans, mortgages aur business banking — teen alag domains — handle karne hain, har domain mein 6-6 tools. Kaunsa agent type?

Lab 2 · Orchestration Simulator

Ek user input likho aur dekho ki generative orchestration kya karta hai — intent nikaalta hai, entities dhoondhta hai, aur knowledge/tools ko reason karke plan banata hai. Phir classic orchestration se compare karo.

Example input try karo: “Mujhe medium size ki red jacket return karni hai, order 4451”

Lab 3 · Topic Trigger Trainer

Classic orchestration mein topic tabhi trigger hota hai jab user input trigger phrases se match kare. Apni trigger phrases likho aur test karo ki kaunse user inputs match karte hain.

Topic: Password reset — trigger phrases (comma se alag karke likho):

Test input:

Lab 4 · Cost Estimator

Copilot Studio mein cost messages se measure hoti hai — har generative answer aur har autonomous action message consume karta hai. Estimate karo ki tumhara agent mahine mein kitne messages use karega.





Lab 5 · PowerFx Playground

Topics mein variables ko PowerFx formulas se calculate karte hain. Neeche ek simple formula evaluator hai — apne values daalkar try karo. (Real Copilot Studio mein PowerFx full language hoti hai; ye lab basic arithmetic aur text functions ke liye hai.)

Formula try karo — jaise: 2 + 3 * 4 ya Upper("hello") ya Concat("Agent: ", "Copilot")

Lab 6 · Knowledge Planner

Apne agent ke liye knowledge sources plan karo. Har source ko add karo aur dekho ki agent ka grounding kitna strong banta hai — aur kya gaps reh gaye.

Lab 7 · Channel Publisher

Agent ko publish karne se pehle channel aur authentication ka decision lo. Apne scenario ke liye sahi combination chuno.

Audience:

Channel:

Pehle audience aur channel chuno.

Lab 8 · Voice + Escalation Flow

Voice agent mein conversation ka flow alag hota hai — messages chhote, confirmations zaroori, aur escalation smooth. Ek call scenario simulate karo.

Scenario: Customer phone par bolta hai: “Mera order late hai, mujhe human se baat karni hai.”

FAQs — interview questions

36 FAQs — Copilot Studio interviews aur real projects mein poochhe jaane wale sawaal, Hinglish mein jawab ke saath.

Q1 · Microsoft Copilot Studio kya hai aur ye Microsoft 365 Copilot se kaise alag hai?

Copilot Studio ek low-code platform hai jahan tum apne agents banate, customize aur publish karte ho. Microsoft 365 Copilot ek ready-made AI assistant hai jo Microsoft 365 apps mein kaam karta hai. Copilot Studio se tum Copilot ko extend kar sakte ho (usme apna knowledge aur actions add karke) ya apne khud ke agents bana sakte ho — jaise IT helpdesk ya customer support agent.

Q2 · Copilot Studio mein agent banane ke liye coding aani chahiye?

Nahi — Copilot Studio low-code hai. Zyada tar kaam no-code hota hai: natural language mein description likho, topics banao, knowledge add karo. Lekin advanced scenarios (PowerFx formulas, REST APIs, Azure integration) ke liye thodi technical knowledge kaam aati hai.

Q3 · Agent, copilot aur chatbot mein kya farak hai?

Chatbot sirf fixed scripted answers deta hai. Copilot user ke context mein kaam karta hai aur productivity badhata hai. Agent isse aage hai — wo reason karta hai, tools use karke actions leta hai, aur autonomous bhi kaam kar sakta hai. Copilot Studio mein tum agents banate ho jo copilot experience ke andar ya alag channels par chalte hain.

Q4 · Conversational agent aur autonomous agent mein kya farak hai?

Conversational agent tab kaam karta hai jab user usse baat karta hai — question-answer aur chat-based tasks. Autonomous agent bina user ke chalta hai — time trigger ya event trigger par, jaise har subah invoices validate karna. Autonomous agents ko generative orchestration chahiye hota hai aur approval gates lagane chahiye.

Q5 · Generative orchestration aur classic orchestration mein kaunsa kab chunna chahiye?

Generative orchestration naye agents ke liye default hai — flexible, multi-intent handle karta hai, reasoning karta hai, lekin cost zyada hai. Classic orchestration tab chuno jab flow fixed aur predictable ho, compliance critical ho, ya cost control karni ho. Classic mein har topic ke liye 5-10 trigger phrases chahiye aur sirf ek intent per input hota hai.

Q6 · Agent ki instructions kaise likhni chahiye?

Instructions mein likho: agent ka purpose, tone (formal/friendly), kya karna hai aur kya NAHI karna hai, aur kis situation mein escalate karna hai. Clear, specific instructions likho — vague instructions se agent galat answers deta hai. Instructions ko test karke iterate karo.

Q7 · Copilot Studio mein grounding kya hoti hai aur ye kyun zaroori hai?

Grounding ka matlab hai agent ko tumhare real data se jawab dene ke liye connect karna — knowledge sources jaise SharePoint, websites, files, Dataverse. Bina grounding ke agent sirf apni training par jawab deta hai, jo outdated ya galat ho sakta hai. Grounding se answers accurate, current aur verifiable hote hain.

Q8 · Knowledge source mein website add karte waqt URL kitne levels deep ja sakta hai?

Sirf 2 levels deep. Agar tum https://example.com/support daalte ho, to agent us page aur uske ek level neeche ke pages padh sakta hai. Isliye knowledge ke liye sahi entry page chuno.

Q9 · Files ko knowledge source banane par wo kahan store hoti hain?

Files Dataverse mein upload hoti hain aur background mein index hoti hain. Jab tak indexing complete na ho, agent un files ko use nahi kar payega — isliye files add karne ke baad thoda wait karo aur phir test karo.

Q10 · Topic kya hota hai aur trigger phrases kyun zaroori hain?

Topic ek conversation ka hissa hota hai — jaise password reset ya order status. Har topic trigger phrases se trigger hota hai (classic orchestration) ya description se (generative orchestration). Achhe trigger phrases user ki real language mein hone chahiye — 5-10 phrases per topic likho.

Q11 · Intent aur entities kya hote hain?

Intent user ka maksad hai — jaise 'return karna'. Entities us maksad ke details hain — jaise product (jacket), size (medium), colour (red), location. Agent intent aur entities nikaalkar sahi topic aur tools choose karta hai.

Q12 · Slot filling kya hai?

Slot filling wo process hai jisme agent missing information poochta hai. Example: user ne kaha 'jacket return karni hai' lekin size nahi bataya — agent poochhega 'kaunsi size ki jacket hai?' Jab saari slots bhar jayein, tabhi action hota hai.

Q13 · Conversational boosting system topic kya karta hai?

Conversational boosting wo system topic hai jo trigger hota hai jab koi topic match na ho (On Unknown Intent trigger). Ye knowledge sources se generative answer banata hai. Ise customize karke tum control kar sakte ho ki unknown questions par agent kya kare — answer de, ya escalate kare.

Q14 · System topics kaunse hote hain aur unhe customize kyun karna chahiye?

System topics wo built-in topics hain jo har agent mein hote hain: Conversation Start (greeting), Conversational boosting (unknown intent), End of Conversation, Escalation, aur Fallback. Inhe customize karna chahiye — khaas taur par greeting message aur escalation flow, kyunki wahi user experience decide karte hain.

Q15 · Copilot Studio mein agent ki cost kaise calculate hoti hai?

Cost messages se measure hoti hai — har generative answer aur har autonomous action message consume karta hai. Classic orchestration wale topics messages consume nahi karte (jab tak generative answer na ho). Payment prepaid message packs (monthly, per tenant) ya pay-as-you-go se hoti hai. Agent usage estimator se estimate karo.

Q16 · Playground Agent kya hai aur iska kya use hai?

Playground Agent ek quick starting point hai — Development environment mein turant banta hai, sirf naam aur description likhna padta hai, aur tum ise Open Access environment mein bhi use kar sakte ho. Experiment karne, ideas test karne aur agent design seekhne ke liye best hai.

Q17 · Development environment aur Open Access environment mein kya farak hai?

Development environment trial environment hai jisme tumhare paas Dataverse store hota hai — professional agents yahin bante hain. Open Access environment mein Dataverse nahi hota — sirf basic agent ban sakta hai. Professional use ke liye hamesha Development environment use karo.

Q18 · Agent ko tools kyun chahiye aur kaunse tools hote hain?

Tools se agent actions leta hai — sirf jawab nahi deta. Tools hote hain: connectors (Outlook, SharePoint), REST APIs, agent flows (Power Automate), prompt tools, aur MCP server tools. Har tool ki clear description likhna zaroori hai — generative orchestration usi se decide karta hai ki tool kab use karna hai.

Q19 · Agent flows kya hote hain aur kab use karne chahiye?

Agent flows Power Automate ke deterministic workflows hain jo agent ke liye actions karte hain — jaise approval lena ya record banana. Deterministic, structured steps ke liye flows best hain; reasoning wale parts generative AI ko do. Flow pehle Power Automate mein test karo, phir agent mein add karo.

Q20 · MCP server kya hai aur ye Copilot Studio mein kaise kaam karta hai?

Model Context Protocol (MCP) ek open standard hai jisse agents external servers se tools le sakte hain. MCP server connect karke tum uske tools apne agent mein add kar sakte ho bina har tool khud banaye. Ye ecosystem ko standardize karta hai.

Q21 · Multi-agent system kab banana chahiye?

Jab agent ko 4-5 se zyada knowledge sources ya tools chahiye, jab domains clearly alag hon, ya jab alag teams alag agents own karti hon. Multi-agent mein ek orchestrator agent specialist agents ko call karta hai. Child agents ek hi agent ke andar bante hain; connected agents pehle se bane hue agents se connect hote hain.

Q22 · Child agents aur connected agents mein kya farak hai?

Child agents ek hi agent ke andar banaye gaye sub-agents hain — tumhare poore control mein. Connected agents pehle se existing agents hote hain (Copilot Studio ke ya bahar ke) jinse tum connect karte ho. Connected agents ka fayda hai ki har team apna agent independently maintain kar sakti hai.

Q23 · Agent ko publish karne se pehle kya check karna chahiye?

Publish checklist: authentication set hai, instructions final hain, knowledge sources sahi hain, tools end-to-end test kiye hain, fallback aur escalation configured hai, greeting message brand voice mein hai, channels decide kiye hain, aur monitoring ready hai. Aur yaad rakho — save karna aur publish karna alag hai; changes live tabhi hote hain jab publish karo.

Q24 · Agent ko kitne channels par publish kar sakte hain?

Ek agent ko multiple channels par publish kar sakte ho — Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, public website, mobile app, social media. Internal agents ke liye Teams aur M365 Copilot best hain; external ke liye website aur mobile app. Har channel par authentication aur branding alag set kar sakte ho.

Q25 · Agent ki performance kaise monitor karte hain?

Analytics dashboard mein sessions, resolution rate, top topics, fallback rate aur CSAT dekho. Transcripts padhkar samjho ki agent ne kya galat kiya. Improvement loop chalao: measure → review → root cause → fix → publish → dobara measure. Autonomous agents ke liye runs, decisions aur human interventions bhi monitor karo.

Q26 · Resolution rate aur fallback rate kya batate hain?

Resolution rate batata hai ki kitne sessions mein user ko answer mila. Fallback rate batata hai ki kitni baar agent ko Conversational boosting ya fallback use karna pada. Zyada fallback rate ka matlab hai topics ya knowledge mein gap hai — naye topics banao ya knowledge improve karo.

Q27 · Voice-enabled agent banate waqt kya alag hota hai?

Voice mein messages chhote hone chahiye (2-3 sentences), trigger phrases spoken language mein likhni chahiye, confirmations use karni chahiye (jaise order number dobara bolna), aur speech version alag se set karni chahiye. Barge-in setting se user agent ke bolte waqt beech mein bol sakta hai.

Q28 · Escalation kab aur kaise configure karte hain?

Escalate karo jab agent answer na jaane, jab user human se baat karna chahe, ya jab issue sensitive ho (refund, complaint). Escalation system topic customize karo — sahi team/queue select karo aur conversation context human agent ko saath bhejo, taaki user ko dobara sab nahi bolna pade.

Q29 · Azure AI Search ko Copilot Studio se kaise connect karte hain?

Pehle Azure AI Search mein vector index banao — data import karke vectorize karo (embedding model se). Phir agent ke Knowledge tab mein Azure AI Search select karke index add karo. Vector search keyword search se behtar hai kyunki wo meaning match karta hai — RAG ke liye ideal hai.

Q30 · Apna Azure AI Foundry model kaise laate hain?

Azure AI Foundry mein model taiyar karke deploy karo, endpoint lo, phir Copilot Studio ki model settings mein 'Bring your own model' select karo. Teen jagah model select kar sakte ho: primary model (reasoning), response model (generative answers), aur prompt tool ka model. Custom model tabhi lao jab default se kaam na bane.

Q31 · Deep reasoning kya hai aur ye kab use hota hai?

Deep reasoning ek setting hai jo complex, multi-step problems ke liye model ko zyada sochne deti hai. Ye sirf generative orchestration ke saath kaam karti hai aur Generative AI settings mein toggle hoti hai. Cost zyada hoti hai, isliye sirf un scenarios mein use karo jahan deep reasoning zaroori ho.

Q32 · Tenant graph grounding kya hai?

Tenant graph grounding se agent tumhare organization ke graph (users, files, meetings, emails) ko semantic search se access kar sakta hai. Ye Microsoft 365 Copilot license ke saath enable hota hai. Isse agent personalized aur context-aware answers de sakta hai.

Q33 · Adaptive cards kya hote hain aur inhe kab use karna chahiye?

Adaptive cards rich, interactive message cards hote hain — jaise forms, buttons, ya structured data display. Inhe topic messages mein use karte hain jab user se structured input chahiye ho ya information visually dikhani ho. Adaptive cards JSON format mein define hote hain.

Q34 · Copilot Studio agent aur Microsoft 365 Copilot license mein kya relation hai?

Microsoft 365 Copilot ka paid license chahiye hota hai tenant graph grounding aur kuch advanced features ke liye. Microsoft 365 Copilot ka koi free trial nahi hai — paid license hi lena padta hai. Copilot Studio trial copilotstudio.microsoft.com par work/school/developer account se mil sakta hai.

Q35 · Agent banane mein sabse common galtiyan kaunsi hain?

Vague instructions likhna, bahut zyada tools/knowledge sources add karna, trigger phrases user ki real language mein na likhna, test kiye bina publish karna, aur publish ke baad monitoring band kar dena. Best practice: chhota shuru karo, test karo, iterate karo, aur monitoring loop kabhi band mat karo.

Q36 · Copilot Studio seekhne ke baad career mein kya opportunities hain?

Copilot Studio aur agent development ki demand tezi se badh rahi hai — roles jaise AI agent developer, Copilot consultant, automation specialist, aur solution architect. Interview mein agent design decisions (orchestration choice, grounding strategy, multi-agent design, cost optimization, monitoring) par sawaal poochhe jate hain — ye sab in notes mein covered hain.
